_spec.purpose: 多益 Part 3 簡短對話題庫；一組＝一段對話＋3題四選一

easy.guide: 兩人、6–8 句、答案幾乎照字面出現

medium.guide: 兩人、6–8 句、同義換句、每組至少 1 題推論或意圖

hard.guide: 三人、10 句以上、先說 A 再改 B、含圖表或意圖題

qtypes.main: 主旨／目的／問題／職業／地點
qtypes.intent: 意圖（題目引用對話中一句話）
qtypes.graphic: 圖表題，題目以 Look at the graphic 開頭，須有 graphic

_spec.entry_schema: {id:d{1-7}-{3位數}-{e|m|h}, domain, scene, tag(中文,不重複), form:'2p'|'3p', level:{score,cefr,tier,why}, speakers:[{id,gender:'F'|'M',role}], dialogue:[{sp,t,zh}], graphic:null|{title,columns:[],rows:[[]]}, questions:[{id:'q1',qtype,q:{t,zh},choices:剛好4個{t,zh,ok,trap(錯誤句,取自traps)|pattern(正解:direct|paraphrase|summary),why}, evidence:[對話句索引從0起,遞增]}] 共3題, vocab:[2–4個{word,ipa,pos,col,zh}]}

rules.choices: 每題 4 選項、剛好 1 正解；正解盡量用同義替換，不照抄對話原字；錯誤選項需有明確對話依據可排除。正解必填 pattern（direct／paraphrase／summary）且不可有 trap；錯誤選項必填 trap（取自 traps）且不可有 pattern；同一題 4 個選項文字不可重複。
rules.order: 3 題的 evidence 依題號遞增。
rules.dialogue: 每句英文 5–25 個單字（"Yes, I did." 這類太短的句子會被健檢警告），口語自然；2p 的說話者 id 用 W／M；3p 須有兩位同性別說話者（id 如 W1／W2／M）；說話者 id 與 speakers 一致，dialogue 的 sp 只能用 speakers 裡的 id；speakers.role 用中文（如「顧客」「服務生」）。
rules.output: 輸出單一合法 JSON 陣列（UTF-8、不加程式碼區塊標記）。
rules.vocab: 每組 2–4 個，word 必須原樣出現在該組對話或題目／選項文字中；每項都要有 word、ipa、pos、col、zh；不得與已用過的 vocab 重複。
rules.graphic: 沒有圖表題的組 graphic 填 null；有圖表題時 graphic 需有 title、columns、rows，且每列欄數與 columns 相同；圖表題答案要結合圖表與對話才能得出。
rules.fields: scene 填該主題允許的場景；level.why 用一句中文說明為何屬此難度；level.tier 與 id 尾碼一致；domain 與 id 的 d{N} 一致。

level.why: 兩人對話，答案幾乎字面出現。

dialogue.t: Hi, Mark. Did you get my email about tomorrow's sales meeting?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，馬克。你收到我寄的明天業務會議的郵件了嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I did. Is it still at ten o'clock?
dialogue.zh: 收到了。還是十點嗎？

dialogue.t: No, it was moved to two in the afternoon, because the projector in Room B is being repaired.
dialogue.zh: 不是，改到下午兩點了，因為 B 室的投影機在維修。

dialogue.t: That works for me. Should I bring the quarterly report?
dialogue.zh: 我可以。我要帶季報告嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, please. And could you print twelve copies before the meeting?
dialogue.zh: 要，麻煩你。可以在會前列印十二份嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. I'll do that this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 好，我今天下午就做。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.why: 對話沒有提到新產品。
正解：會議時間由十點改到下午兩點。
壞掉的是投影機，列印只是附帶任務。
季報告只是要帶去的資料，不是討論重點。

q.t: Why was the meeting time changed?
q.zh: 會議時間為什麼更改？

choices.why: 沒有提到經理出差。
正解：projector is being repaired → equipment needs repairs。
沒有人缺席。
提到 Room B，但原因不是空間。

q.t: What will the man do this afternoon?
q.zh: 男士今天下午要做什麼？

choices.why: 維修投影機的不是他。
沒有提到預約會議室。
寄郵件的是女士。
正解：print twelve copies → make some copies。

level.why: 需同義換句理解，並推論客戶可能改找別家。

dialogue.t: Karen, have you sent the revised quote to Hartley Industries yet?
dialogue.zh: Karen，你把修訂後的報價單寄給 Hartley Industries 了嗎？

dialogue.t: Not yet. I'm still waiting for the supplier to confirm the new shipping costs.
dialogue.zh: 還沒。我還在等供應商確認新的運費。

dialogue.t: Hartley wanted it by noon, so they might go with another vendor.
dialogue.zh: Hartley 要求中午前拿到，所以他們可能改找別家廠商。

dialogue.t: I know. I'll call the supplier again, and I might have to estimate the figure.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我會再打給供應商，也許得先估算那個數字。

dialogue.t: Please don't guess. An incorrect quote would look worse than a late one.
dialogue.zh: 請不要用猜的。錯誤的報價比遲交更難看。

dialogue.t: You're right. I'll tell Hartley we'll have an accurate quote by this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。我會告訴 Hartley 今天下午前提供準確報價。

q.t: What is the woman's problem?
q.zh: 女士的問題是什麼？

choices.why: Hartley 只是可能改找別家，並未取消訂單。

choices.t: Some cost details have not been confirmed.
choices.zh: 有些費用細節尚未確認。
choices.why: 正解：她還在等供應商確認新的運費。
提到運費，但沒有提到貨物送達。
經理只是在催報價，沒有拒絕任何提案。

q.t: What does the man imply about Hartley Industries?
q.zh: 男士對 Hartley Industries 暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It may do business with another company.
choices.zh: 它可能改和別家公司交易。
choices.why: 正解：might go with another vendor 暗示客戶可能流失。
客戶要求中午前拿到，與此相反。
Hartley 是收報價的客戶，不是供應商。

choices.t: It has already received the quote.
choices.why: 報價單還沒寄出。

q.t: What will the woman most likely do next?
q.zh: 女士接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.why: 男士要她不要用猜的。
正解：I'll call the supplier again。

choices.zh: 拜訪 Hartley 的辦公室。
choices.why: 沒有提到拜訪客戶。
她要拿到準確數字，下午才提供。

level.why: 三人對話、含意圖題與圖表題，需整合數字與設備條件。

dialogue.t: We need a room for the new-hire training on Thursday. How many people are coming?
dialogue.zh: 我們需要一間教室辦週四的新人訓練。會有多少人？

dialogue.t: Eighteen, I think. Although Priya mentioned two more might join.
dialogue.zh: 我想是十八人。不過 Priya 說可能再多兩個。

dialogue.t: That's right. Twenty people in total, and we'll need a projector.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。總共二十人，而且需要投影機。

dialogue.t: Okay. Room A is the biggest, but it's closed for painting.
dialogue.zh: 好。A 室最大，但在粉刷。

dialogue.t: What about Room B? It's smaller, but I'd rather not squeeze everyone in.
dialogue.zh: B 室呢？它比較小，但我不想把大家擠在一起。

dialogue.t: Room B only holds fifteen. Room C fits twenty-five and has a screen.
dialogue.zh: B 室只能容納十五人。C 室可坐二十五人，還有螢幕。

dialogue.t: Then C is the obvious choice. Would you book it, Dana?
dialogue.zh: 那 C 室顯然最好。Dana，你可以預約嗎？

dialogue.t: I will, right after I confirm the catering order.
dialogue.zh: 我會，確認完餐點訂單就辦。

q.t: What are the speakers trying to do?
q.zh: 說話者想做什麼？

choices.why: 訓練對象是新進員工，但不是在招人。
餐點只在最後一句提到。
粉刷的是 A 室，與目的無關。

choices.t: Select a space for a training
choices.why: 正解：整段在比較教室以辦理訓練。

q.t: What does the man imply when he says, "I'd rather not squeeze everyone in"?
q.zh: 男士說「我不想把大家擠在一起」暗示什麼？

choices.t: Room B may be too small.
choices.why: 正解：B 室比較小，他擔心容納不下二十人。
粉刷只是 A 室不能用的原因。
他是想換教室，不是減少人數。
沒有任何取消的跡象。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which room will the speakers use?
q.zh: 看圖表，說話者會使用哪間教室？

choices.why: A 室雖最大，但在粉刷。
只有 15 個座位，容納不了 20 人。
正解：25 個座位，有螢幕；男士選 C。
圖表有 20 座位但沒有設備，與需求不符。

level.why: 對話簡短，答案幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Hello, Anna. Can I book Meeting Room 3 for tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 哈囉，Anna。我可以預約明天的 3 號會議室嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. What time do you need it?
dialogue.zh: 當然。你需要幾點？

dialogue.t: From two to four in the afternoon. I have an interview.
dialogue.zh: 下午兩點到四點。我有一場面試。

dialogue.t: Sorry, Room 3 is busy then. Room 5 is free.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，3 號那時有人用。5 號是空的。

dialogue.t: That's fine. Is there a screen in Room 5?
dialogue.zh: 可以。5 號有螢幕嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, there is. I'll put your name on the schedule.
dialogue.zh: 有的。我會把你的名字寫進時間表。

dialogue.t: Thank you. I'll be there at two o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我兩點會到。

q.t: What is the man asking about?
q.zh: 男士在詢問什麼？

choices.why: 提到 interview，但他問的是借會議室。
只問 5 號室有沒有螢幕，不是修理。
正解：Can I book Meeting Room 3?
完全沒有提到午餐。

q.t: Which room will the man use?
q.zh: 男士會使用哪一間會議室？

choices.why: two 是時間（兩點），不是房號。
他原本想借，但那時段已被使用。
four 是結束時間（四點）。
正解：Room 5 is free，他接受了。

q.t: What will the woman do next?
q.zh: 女士接下來要做什麼？

choices.t: Add the man's name to a schedule
choices.zh: 把男士的名字加到時間表
choices.why: 正解：I'll put your name on the schedule。
5 號室本來就有螢幕。
要面試的是男士。
3 號室沒空，才改借 5 號。

level.why: 需聽出男士建議刪減的言外之意。

dialogue.t: Tom, do you have a few minutes? I'd like your opinion on my presentation.
dialogue.zh: Tom，你有幾分鐘嗎？我想聽聽你對我簡報的意見。

dialogue.t: Sure, but I have a call with a client at three, so we'll need to be quick.
dialogue.zh: 好，不過我三點要和客戶通話，所以得快一點。

dialogue.t: That's fine. I'm presenting to the board tomorrow, and I'm worried it's too long.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我明天要向董事會簡報，我擔心太長。

dialogue.t: Well, there are forty slides here. Most executives prefer a shorter format.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這裡有四十張投影片。多數高階主管偏好簡短的形式。

dialogue.t: Hmm, I thought more detail would impress them. What would you cut?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我以為更多細節會讓他們印象深刻。你會刪哪裡？

dialogue.t: Start with the background section. Then send me the new version tonight, and I'll review it.
dialogue.zh: 先從背景那段開始。然後今晚把新版寄給我，我來看看。

dialogue.t: Great idea. I'll trim it this evening.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我今天傍晚就來刪減。

q.t: What does the woman ask the man to do?
q.zh: 女士請男士做什麼？

choices.t: Attend a board meeting for her.
choices.why: 明天向董事會簡報的是女士本人。
正解：她想聽他對簡報的意見。
這是男士的建議，不是女士的請求。
客戶電話是男士的行程，不是她的請求。

q.t: What does the man imply when he says, "Most executives prefer a shorter format"?
q.zh: 男士說「多數高階主管偏好簡短的形式」暗示什麼？

choices.why: 正解：提到四十張後才說這句，暗示太長。
沒有任何延期的暗示。
他的意思是要更精簡。
他們偏好簡短的，並非討厭簡報本身。

q.t: What will the woman do this evening?
q.zh: 女士今天傍晚要做什麼？

choices.why: 董事會簡報是明天，不是今晚。
正解：I'll trim it this evening。
要審閱新版的是男士。
完全沒有提到訂購。

level.why: 三人對話先訂火車後改搭飛機，需結合圖表的時間與價格及對話中的限制才能作答。

dialogue.t: Okay, let's settle the travel plan for the Chicago client visit next Friday.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們來敲定下週五拜訪芝加哥客戶的行程。

dialogue.t: The meeting starts at twelve thirty, so we should arrive at least an hour early.
dialogue.zh: 會議十二點半開始，所以我們至少要提早一小時抵達。

dialogue.t: I'd suggest the morning train. It's cheap, and we could prepare our slides on board.
dialogue.zh: 我建議搭早班火車。很便宜，而且可以在車上準備簡報。

dialogue.t: That sounds good. I'll buy three seats on the six o'clock train right now.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。我現在就買三個六點那班火車的座位。

dialogue.t: Wait, I just heard the rail workers are on strike that day. Check before you buy anything.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我剛聽說那天鐵路工人要罷工。買之前先確認。

dialogue.t: You're right. The railway website says all Friday trains have been canceled.
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。鐵路網站說週五所有班次都取消了。

dialogue.t: Then we'll have to fly. Is there a spending limit for each person?
dialogue.zh: 那我們得搭飛機了。每個人有花費上限嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, the finance office won't approve anything above one hundred seventy dollars per traveler.
dialogue.zh: 有，財務部不會核准每位出差者超過一百七十美元的費用。

dialogue.t: Understood. I'd also rather skip the bus, since it would get us there too late.
dialogue.zh: 了解。我也寧可不搭巴士，因為會太晚到。

dialogue.t: Agreed. I'll pick a flight that fits and send you both the confirmation by tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 同意。我會挑一班合適的航班，明天前把確認信寄給你們兩位。

dialogue.t: Perfect. Please also arrange a taxi from the airport to the client's office.
dialogue.zh: 很好。也請安排從機場到客戶辦公室的計程車。

q.t: Why will the team not take the train?
q.zh: 團隊為什麼不搭火車？

choices.t: Service has been suspended that day.
choices.why: 正解：鐵路工人罷工，週五所有班次取消。
火車被形容為便宜，且票價並非原因。

choices.t: The meeting was moved to another day.
choices.why: 會議時間沒有更動，改變的是交通方式。

choices.t: The train would arrive too late.
choices.why: 太晚到的是巴士，不是火車。

q.t: What does the man imply about the finance office?
q.zh: 關於財務部，男士暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It restricts how much employees can spend on travel.
choices.zh: 它限制員工的出差花費。
choices.why: 正解：不核准超過一百七十美元的費用。

choices.t: It will approve any flight price.
choices.zh: 它會核准任何機票價格。
choices.why: 相反：有每人一百七十美元的上限。
沒有任何線索顯示財務部取消會議。

choices.t: It is arranging the airport taxi.
choices.why: 計程車是男士請同事安排，與財務部無關。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which option will the team most likely choose?
q.zh: 請看圖表。團隊最可能選哪一個選項？

choices.why: 正解：11:15 抵達，趕得上十一點半前；$160 未超過 $170。
雖然最早到，但 $210 超過每人 $170 的上限。
原本的計畫，但當天班次已取消。
12:30 才到，趕不上提早一小時抵達的要求。

level.why: 資訊直接說出，只需對照圖表找房號。

dialogue.t: Paul, are you going to a training session today?
dialogue.zh: Paul，你今天要去上訓練課嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes. I want to learn how to use the new software.
dialogue.zh: 對。我想學怎麼使用新軟體。

dialogue.t: Then you should take the Computer Skills class.
dialogue.zh: 那你應該上電腦技能課。

dialogue.t: What time does it start?
dialogue.zh: 它幾點開始？

dialogue.zh: 九點開始。別遲到。

dialogue.t: I won't. I'll leave my desk at ten to nine.
dialogue.zh: 不會。我八點五十分離開座位。

q.zh: 男士為什麼想參加訓練？

choices.why: 沒有提到新經理。
課程與電腦有關，但目的是學軟體，不是領電腦。
正解：learn how to use the new software。
沒有任何旅行的線索。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which room will the man go to?
q.zh: 看圖表，男士會去哪一間教室？

choices.why: 那是 Team Building 的教室。
正解：他要上 Computer Skills，圖表顯示在 Room 2。
圖表中沒有 Room 3。
那是 Safety Training 與 Customer Service 的教室。

q.t: What time will the man leave his desk?
q.zh: 男士幾點離開座位？

choices.why: 正解：ten to nine ＝ 8:50。
這是課程開始時間。
把 ten to nine 誤聽成九點過十分。
ten 與 nine 混淆，也與安全課的時間混淆。

level.why: 需結合圖表與對話，並理解引用句的真正用意。

dialogue.t: Ben, the printer is almost out of toner. Could you order a new cartridge today?
dialogue.zh: Ben，印表機的碳粉快用完了。你今天可以訂一個新的碳粉匣嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. Let me check the supplier's list. A cartridge costs forty-five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 好，我看一下供應商的清單。一個碳粉匣四十五美元。

dialogue.t: That's fine. When would it arrive? We need to print handouts for Monday's workshop.
dialogue.zh: 可以。什麼時候會到？我們要為星期一的工作坊列印講義。

dialogue.t: Standard delivery takes five days, but express delivery cuts it to two days for an extra fee.
dialogue.zh: 標準配送要五天，快遞可縮短為兩天，但要加收費用。

dialogue.t: It's Thursday, so five days is too late. Please choose the express option.
dialogue.zh: 今天星期四，所以五天太晚了。請選快遞。

dialogue.t: Understood. I'll use my company card and send you the confirmation.
dialogue.zh: 了解。我會用公司卡付款，並把確認信寄給你。

q.t: Why does the woman need the toner?
q.zh: 女士為什麼需要碳粉？

choices.zh: 為了更換壞掉的印表機
choices.why: 印表機只是碳粉快用完，並沒有壞。

choices.t: To prepare materials for a workshop
choices.zh: 為了準備工作坊的資料
choices.why: 正解：print handouts for Monday's workshop。
沒有提到發票或客戶。

choices.t: To meet a supplier on Thursday
choices.zh: 為了星期四與供應商見面
choices.why: 星期四只是說話當天，不是與供應商見面。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much extra will the company pay for delivery?
q.zh: 看圖表，公司需額外支付多少運費？

choices.why: 這是標準配送，但她選了快遞。
正解：選快遞（2 天），圖表上加收 $15。
這是隔夜配送的費用。
這是碳粉匣的價格，不是運費。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "five days is too late"?
q.zh: 女士為什麼說「五天太晚了」？

choices.why: 她選了要加價的快遞。
正解：星期一要用，所以拒絕標準配送。

choices.t: She will be away on Monday.
choices.why: 星期一有工作坊，沒有說她缺席。

choices.t: She is unsure about the order.
choices.why: 她明確要求下單並選擇快遞。

level.why: 三人對話先排訓練後因筆電延遲改期，需掌握計畫轉折與說話者語氣意圖。

dialogue.t: Our new analyst, Jenna, starts on Monday, so let's finalize her first-week plan.
dialogue.zh: 我們的新分析師 Jenna 週一報到，所以來敲定她第一週的計畫。

dialogue.t: I'd like her to begin the financial reports training on Monday morning.
dialogue.zh: 我希望她週一早上就開始財務報表訓練。

dialogue.t: Her laptop should be ready by then. I only need to install the accounting programs.
dialogue.zh: 她的筆電到時應該準備好了。我只需要安裝會計程式。

dialogue.t: Great. I'll set up her desk near the window, so she can meet the whole team.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我會把她的座位安排在窗邊，讓她認識整個團隊。

dialogue.t: Actually, I just got an email. The shipment of new laptops won't arrive until Wednesday.
dialogue.zh: 其實我剛收到一封郵件。新筆電的貨要到週三才會到。

dialogue.t: Then training on Monday won't work. She can't practice without a computer.
dialogue.zh: 那週一的訓練就不行了。沒有電腦她無法練習。

dialogue.t: How about spending Monday and Tuesday meeting the team and reviewing company policies?
dialogue.zh: 週一和週二用來認識團隊並了解公司規定如何？

dialogue.t: That's better. At least she won't be sitting around with nothing to do.
dialogue.zh: 這樣比較好。至少她不會閒坐著沒事做。

dialogue.t: I could lend her a spare computer, but it's quite slow and outdated.
dialogue.zh: 我可以借她一台備用電腦，但它很慢又過時。

dialogue.t: Let's not rush that. Please just configure the new laptop on Wednesday morning.
dialogue.zh: 先不用急著這樣做。請在週三早上把新筆電設定好就好。

dialogue.t: Understood. I'll set it up as soon as it arrives and let Jenna know.
dialogue.zh: 了解。筆電一到我就設定好，並通知 Jenna。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Scheduling a new employee's first week
choices.zh: 安排新進員工的第一週行程
choices.why: 正解：討論 Jenna 第一週的訓練、座位與電腦。

choices.t: Ordering new laptops for the department
choices.why: 筆電只是延遲的原因，不是討論主題。

choices.t: Interviewing candidates for an open position
choices.why: Jenna 已錄取並即將報到，沒有面試。

choices.t: Moving the team to a different floor
choices.why: 只提到安排座位，沒有搬遷。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "At least she won't be sitting around with nothing to do"?
q.zh: 男士說「至少她不會閒坐著沒事做」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The new employee will have useful activities.
choices.zh: 新進員工會有有意義的活動可做。
choices.why: 正解：週一、週二安排認識團隊與了解規定。
相反：訓練只是延到週三。
完全沒有提到居家工作。

choices.t: Jenna will use the old computer.
choices.why: 舊電腦是女士提議，男士說先不用急。

q.t: What does the man ask the IT specialist to do?
q.zh: 男士要求資訊部專員做什麼？

choices.t: Prepare a new computer on Wednesday
choices.why: 正解：Configure the new laptop on Wednesday morning。
這是女士的提議，男士表示先不用急著這樣做。

choices.t: Install the accounting programs on Monday
choices.why: 這是原本的計畫，因貨延遲已無法進行。
沒有人提到取消，只是要等到週三。

level.why: 兩人對話，訂位時間與要求幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Good evening, Bayside Grill. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 晚安，這裡是海灣燒烤。有什麼我能為您效勞的嗎？

dialogue.t: Hi, I'd like to reserve a table for six on Friday night.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想訂星期五晚上六個人的位子。

dialogue.t: Certainly. What time would you like to come?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。您想幾點來呢？

dialogue.t: Around seven, please. It's for my sister's birthday.
dialogue.zh: 大約七點。這是為我妹妹的生日。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry, we only have a table at eight o'clock on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，星期五我們只剩八點的位子。

dialogue.t: Eight is fine. Could we sit near the window?
dialogue.zh: 八點可以。我們可以坐靠窗的位子嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I'll note that. May I have your phone number and a name for the booking?
dialogue.zh: 可以，我會記下來。可以請您給我電話號碼和訂位姓名嗎？

q.t: Why is the man calling?
q.zh: 男士為什麼打電話？

choices.why: 對話沒有提到外送，他是要訂位。

choices.t: To book seats for a meal
choices.why: 正解：reserve a table → book seats for a meal。
生日只是用餐原因，不是來電目的。

choices.zh: 為了更改星期五的訂位
choices.why: 他是新訂位，沒有提到既有訂位。

q.t: When will the man's group eat on Friday?
q.zh: 男士一行人星期五何時用餐？

choices.why: 六是人數，不是時間。
七點是他想要的時間，但餐廳沒有位子。
正解：we only have a table at eight o'clock，男士回答 Eight is fine。
對話沒有提到九點。

q.t: What will the man probably do next?
q.zh: 男士接下來可能會做什麼？

choices.t: Choose a dish from the menu
choices.why: 對話沒有提到點餐。
這個要求他已經提過了。
女士沒有要求訂金。
正解：女士要電話號碼和姓名 → contact details。

level.why: 需聽懂數字差異並用同義換句理解帳單錯誤，另含一題語意意圖。

dialogue.t: Excuse me, I think there's a mistake on our bill.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我覺得我們的帳單有錯。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry about that. Which item looks wrong to you?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。你覺得哪一項不對？

dialogue.t: We ordered two appetizers, but I see three listed here.
dialogue.zh: 我們點了兩份開胃菜，但這裡列了三份。

dialogue.t: Let me check with the kitchen. The system may have counted one twice.
dialogue.zh: 我向廚房確認一下。系統可能重複計算了一份。

dialogue.t: That would explain the extra fourteen dollars on the total.
dialogue.zh: 這就解釋了總額多出的十四美元。

dialogue.t: You're right. I'll remove it and bring you a corrected receipt in a minute.
dialogue.zh: 您說得對。我會刪掉它，馬上給您一張更正過的收據。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Could you also pack up our leftover pasta?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。可以也幫我們把剩下的義大利麵打包嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. I'll take care of both things now.
dialogue.zh: 當然。這兩件事我現在就處理。

q.t: Why is the woman talking to the waiter?
q.zh: 女士為什麼和服務生說話？

choices.t: To point out an error on a bill
choices.why: 正解：mistake on our bill 換成 error on a bill。
對話提到開胃菜，但是在說帳單算錯，不是要加點。

choices.t: To complain about the food quality
choices.why: 全文沒有對食物品質表達不滿。

choices.t: To ask for a discount on the meal
choices.why: 她只要求更正多收的金額，沒有要求折扣。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "That would explain the extra fourteen dollars on the total"?
q.zh: 女士說「這就解釋了總額多出的十四美元」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She thinks the repeated item caused the higher charge.
choices.zh: 她認為重複計算的品項造成金額偏高。
choices.why: 正解：系統多算一份開胃菜，剛好說明多出的金額。

choices.t: She plans to leave a fourteen-dollar tip.
choices.zh: 她打算留十四美元小費。
choices.why: 十四美元是多收的金額，不是小費。

choices.t: She is happy that the meal cost less than expected.
choices.zh: 她很高興餐點比預期便宜。
choices.why: 金額是「多出」，與此相反。

choices.t: She believes the kitchen made a wrong dish.
choices.zh: 她認為廚房做錯了餐點。
choices.why: 對話討論的是帳單重複計算，不是餐點做錯。

q.t: What will the man most likely do next?
q.zh: 男士接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Correct the bill and wrap up some food
choices.why: 正解：他會刪除多算的一項、給更正收據，並處理打包剩菜。
部分正確：他也答應處理打包剩菜（both things）。

choices.t: Add a third appetizer to the order
choices.zh: 在訂單中再加第三份開胃菜
choices.why: 相反：他要刪掉多算的那一份。

choices.t: Cook a new plate of pasta
choices.why: 女士只是要打包剩下的麵，沒有要重做。

level.why: 三人先選 Mario's 再因整修改選別家，並需理解「只有一小時」的言外之意。

dialogue.t: Let's decide where to hold the team's celebration lunch this Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 我們來決定這週四團隊慶功午餐要辦在哪裡。

dialogue.t: I'm thinking Mario's. Their pasta is great, and it's only a block away.
dialogue.zh: 我想去 Mario's。他們的義大利麵很棒，而且只隔一個街區。

dialogue.t: Mario's sounds nice. I'll call them now and ask for a table for twelve.
dialogue.zh: Mario's 聽起來不錯。我現在就打給他們，詢問十二人的座位。

dialogue.t: Hold on. I just walked past, and a sign says they're closed for renovation.
dialogue.zh: 等等。我剛走過去，有張告示說他們整修停業。

dialogue.t: That's unfortunate. Do either of you know another place that fits twelve people?
dialogue.zh: 真可惜。你們有人知道另一家能容納十二人的地方嗎？

dialogue.t: Lakeview Café has a large back room, and the owner gives discounts for big groups.
dialogue.zh: Lakeview Café 有間大的後廳，而且老闆對大團體有折扣。

dialogue.t: Isn't that far? We only have an hour for lunch on Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 那不是很遠嗎？我們週四午餐只有一個小時。

dialogue.t: It's a ten-minute walk, and they can have our orders ready if we send them in advance.
dialogue.zh: 走路十分鐘，而且如果我們先送出餐點，他們可以事先準備好。

dialogue.t: That settles it. Can you collect everyone's choices by Wednesday noon?
dialogue.zh: 那就這麼決定。你可以在週三中午前收集大家的選擇嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. I'll send a form to the team this afternoon and forward the list to the café.
dialogue.zh: 好。我今天下午會寄表單給團隊，再把名單轉給咖啡廳。

dialogue.t: I'll call the owner tomorrow to ask about the group discount.
dialogue.zh: 我明天會打給老闆詢問團體折扣。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Choosing a place for a team meal
choices.why: 正解：他們在決定慶功午餐的餐廳。
沒有任何線索顯示是退休派對。
只提到義大利麵很好吃，並非討論重點。
整修的是 Mario's 餐廳，不是辦公室。

q.t: Why do the speakers change their original plan?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼改變原本的計畫？

choices.t: A restaurant is temporarily shut for remodeling.
choices.zh: 一家餐廳因整修暫時休業。
choices.why: 正解：closed for renovation 換成 shut for remodeling。

choices.t: A restaurant is too far from the office.
choices.zh: 一家餐廳離辦公室太遠。
choices.why: 太遠的疑慮是針對 Lakeview，而且不是改變計畫的原因。

choices.t: A restaurant cannot seat twelve people.
choices.zh: 一家餐廳坐不下十二人。
choices.why: Mario's 沒有說座位不足，是整修停業。

choices.t: A restaurant owner refused to give a discount.
choices.why: 老闆是願意給大團體折扣。

q.t: What does the woman imply when she says, "We only have an hour for lunch on Thursday"?
q.zh: 女士說「我們週四午餐只有一個小時」暗示什麼？

choices.t: The restaurant should not be far away.
choices.why: 正解：她擔心 Lakeview 太遠，會用掉午休時間。

choices.t: She wants a longer lunch break.
choices.why: 她只是陳述時間限制，沒有要求延長。

choices.t: She does not want to eat at a café.
choices.why: 她擔心的是距離，不是店家類型。

choices.t: The team should skip lunch altogether.
choices.zh: 團隊應該乾脆不吃午餐。
choices.why: 完全沒有這個意思，後面還在討論點餐。

level.why: 兩人對話，點餐情境單純，答案多半照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Are you ready to order, ma'am?
dialogue.zh: 女士，您準備好點餐了嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes. I'll have the grilled chicken with a side salad, please.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我要烤雞肉配一份附餐沙拉。

dialogue.t: Would you like soup or fries with it? Today's soup is tomato.
dialogue.zh: 要搭配湯還是薯條？今天的湯是番茄湯。

dialogue.t: I don't eat tomatoes. Is there another soup?
dialogue.zh: 我不吃番茄。有別的湯嗎？

dialogue.t: We also have mushroom soup. It's very popular.
dialogue.zh: 我們也有蘑菇湯。它非常受歡迎。

dialogue.t: Great, I'll take that. And a glass of water, please.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我要那個。再給我一杯水。

dialogue.t: Of course. Your meal will be ready in about fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。您的餐點大約十五分鐘後會好。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "I don't eat tomatoes"?
q.zh: 女士為什麼說「我不吃番茄」？

choices.t: She would like to try tomato soup.
choices.why: 意思相反，她不想要番茄湯。
對話沒有提到份量。

choices.t: She wants to avoid a certain soup.
choices.why: 正解：今天的湯是番茄湯，她因此想換別的湯。

choices.t: She needs more time to decide.
choices.why: 她已經點了烤雞肉，並接著問別的湯。

q.t: What does the man imply about the mushroom soup?
q.zh: 關於蘑菇湯，男士暗示了什麼？

choices.why: 沒有提到是新菜。
番茄指的是另一種湯。

choices.t: It costs less than the other soup.
choices.why: 沒有提到價格。
正解：very popular → many customers like it。

q.t: How long will the woman wait for her meal?
q.zh: 女士的餐點要等多久？

choices.why: 五分鐘不是原文數字。
正解：ready in about fifteen minutes。
fifty 與 fifteen 發音相近，原文是 fifteen。
對話沒有提到三十分鐘。

level.why: 需結合圖表的成分與價格，並推論說話者必須避開的食材。

dialogue.t: Before I order, are any of your dishes made with peanuts?
dialogue.zh: 點餐前想請問，你們有哪些菜用了花生嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, the Pad Thai is. Do you have an allergy?
dialogue.zh: 有，泰式炒河粉有。您會過敏嗎？

dialogue.t: I do, and I can't have dairy either, so I have to be careful.
dialogue.zh: 會，而且我也不能吃乳製品，所以得小心。

dialogue.t: Then please skip the curry. The chef can also adjust a dish if you'd like.
dialogue.zh: 那請避開咖哩。如果您需要，主廚也能調整菜色。

dialogue.t: Thanks. I'd like something light, and I don't want to spend more than fifteen dollars.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我想吃清淡的，而且不想花超過十五美元。

dialogue.t: That narrows it down. I'll tell the kitchen about your allergy right now.
dialogue.zh: 那範圍就縮小了。我現在就告訴廚房您會過敏。

dialogue.t: I appreciate that. I'd rather be safe than sorry.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。我寧可謹慎一點。

q.t: What is implied about the man?
q.zh: 關於男士，文中暗示了什麼？

choices.t: He needs to avoid certain ingredients.
choices.why: 正解：他對花生過敏且不能吃乳製品。

choices.t: He has eaten at the restaurant before.
choices.why: 沒有任何線索顯示他來過。

choices.t: He is allergic only to dairy.
choices.why: 部分正確：他也要避開花生。

choices.t: He would like to order takeout.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到外帶。

q.t: What does the waitress offer to do?
q.zh: 女服務生提議做什麼？

choices.t: Change how a dish is prepared
choices.why: 正解：The chef can also adjust a dish 換成 change how a dish is prepared。
相反：她建議他避開咖哩。

choices.t: Give him a discount on the curry
choices.why: 咖哩只是被提醒避開，沒有提到折扣。

choices.t: Move him to a quieter table
choices.zh: 請他換到較安靜的桌位
choices.why: 對話沒有提到換座位。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which dish will the man most likely order?
q.zh: 請看圖表。男士最可能點哪一道菜？

choices.why: 正解：不含花生與乳製品，且 $12 低於 15 美元。
相反：含花生，他會過敏。
含乳製品，且 $16 超過預算。
雖不含花生與乳製品，但 $18 超過 15 美元。

level.why: 座位由戶外改室內且人數增加，需結合座位圖表與對話條件才能選出桌位。

dialogue.t: The Parker party is arriving at seven tonight. Have we prepared their table yet?
dialogue.zh: 帕克一行人今晚七點到。我們準備好他們的桌位了嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I put them at Table Three on the patio, since they asked for fresh air.
dialogue.zh: 有，我把他們安排在露台的三號桌，因為他們想要新鮮空氣。

dialogue.t: Good choice. The weather is lovely right now, and the lanterns look beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 很好的選擇。現在天氣很棒，燈籠也很漂亮。

dialogue.t: Actually, the forecast says heavy rain will start around six thirty tonight.
dialogue.zh: 其實預報說今晚六點半左右會下大雨。

dialogue.t: Then we can't seat anyone outside. We'll need to move the Parkers indoors.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就不能讓任何人坐在戶外。得把帕克一行人移到室內。

dialogue.t: There's one more thing. Mr. Parker called to say two more guests are joining them.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事。帕克先生來電說還有兩位客人要加入。

dialogue.t: So that's ten people in total. We'll need an indoor table that fits them all.
dialogue.zh: 那總共就是十個人。我們需要一張室內且坐得下所有人的桌子。

dialogue.t: Not the private room, though. A wedding rehearsal dinner already booked it all evening.
dialogue.zh: 不過私人包廂不行。一場婚禮預演晚宴已經訂下整個晚上。

dialogue.t: Right. I'll reset the table and print a new seating card for them.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我會重新布置桌子，並印一張新的座位卡。

dialogue.t: I'll tell the kitchen about the larger party so they can staff the grill accordingly.
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴廚房人數變多，讓他們相應安排烤爐人手。

dialogue.t: Please do. And ask the bartender to prepare a welcome drink for the group.
dialogue.zh: 請去說。也請吧台準備一份團體的迎賓飲料。

q.t: What does the man imply about the patio?
q.zh: 關於露台，男士暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It may be unusable later tonight.
choices.zh: 今晚稍後可能無法使用。
choices.why: 正解：預報六點半會下大雨。
只是今晚下雨，沒有永久關閉。

choices.t: It is reserved for another event.
choices.why: 被預訂的是私人包廂，不是露台。

choices.t: It is too small for the Parker party.
choices.why: 三號桌有八個座位，問題是下雨，不是大小。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which table will the Parker party most likely use?
q.zh: 請看圖表。帕克一行人最可能使用哪一桌？

choices.why: 正解：下雨需室內、共十人，私人包廂已被訂走，只剩 10 人座室內桌。
原本的露台座位，只有八席且在戶外。
雖在室內，但只有四個座位。
座位夠，但是私人包廂已被婚禮預演晚宴訂走。

q.t: What will the man most likely do next?
q.zh: 男士接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Inform the kitchen about the group size
choices.why: 正解：He says he'll tell the kitchen about the larger party。
這是帶位員（W2）要做的事。
這是請吧台人員做的事。
帕克先生來電是已發生的事，沒有說要回電。

level.why: 兩人對話，優惠券與後續安排都清楚出現。

dialogue.t: That was a great lunch. Should we ask for the check?
dialogue.zh: 那頓午餐很棒。我們要請他拿帳單嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, let's split it. I'll call the waiter.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們平分吧。我來叫服務生。

dialogue.t: Wait, I have a coupon for ten percent off a main dish.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我有一張主餐九折的優惠券。

dialogue.t: Really? Does it work for lunch, or only dinner?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？午餐能用，還是只能晚餐用？

dialogue.t: It says any meal until the end of this month.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫本月底前任何一餐都能用。

dialogue.t: Perfect. Please show it to the waiter when he comes.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。服務生來的時候請拿給他看。

dialogue.t: I will. Do you want to get coffee after this?
dialogue.zh: 我會的。吃完你想去喝咖啡嗎？

dialogue.t: I can't. I have a client meeting at two o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 我不行。我兩點有個客戶會議。

q.t: What does the man have?
q.zh: 男士有什麼？

choices.why: 咖啡是之後才提到的邀約。
正解：a coupon for ten percent off → discount coupon。
有會議的是女士。
對話沒有提到訂位。

q.t: What will the man do when the waiter comes?
q.zh: 服務生來的時候，男士會做什麼？

choices.why: 叫服務生的是女士。
咖啡是他邀約女士的活動，沒說要在這時點。
他們說好要平分，與此相反。
正解：show it to the waiter → present a discount。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "I have a client meeting at two o'clock"?
q.zh: 女士為什麼說「我兩點有個客戶會議」？

choices.t: To ask the man to join a meeting
choices.why: 她沒有邀請男士開會。
對話沒有提到換餐廳。
正解：男士問要不要喝咖啡，她回答 I can't 並說明原因。
她沒有抱怨服務。

level.why: 需從語意推知備案需求，並結合圖表時間計算實際到貨時間。

dialogue.t: Chef, lunch starts at eleven. Has the seafood delivery come in yet?
dialogue.zh: 主廚，午餐十一點開始。海鮮送來了嗎？

dialogue.t: Not yet. The supplier called to say their truck broke down.
dialogue.zh: 還沒。供應商打電話說他們的貨車故障了。

dialogue.t: How late will it be? We can't just wait and hope.
dialogue.zh: 會晚多久？我們不能只是乾等著期待。

dialogue.t: About three hours behind their usual time, so we should change today's menu.
dialogue.zh: 比平常時間晚約三小時，所以我們得更動今天的菜單。

dialogue.t: Okay. Could you replace the fish tacos with something we already have?
dialogue.zh: 好。你可以把魚肉塔可換成我們現有食材做的菜嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. I'll make chicken wraps, since we have plenty of chicken in the freezer.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我來做雞肉捲，因為冷凍庫裡有很多雞肉。

dialogue.t: Perfect. I'll update the menu board and let the servers know.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我會更新菜單板並通知服務生。

q.t: What does the woman imply when she says, "We can't just wait and hope"?
q.zh: 女士說「我們不能只是乾等著期待」暗示什麼？

choices.t: The kitchen needs a backup plan.
choices.why: 正解：她接著就要求更動菜單，找替代方案。

choices.t: Customers will wait for their orders.
choices.why: 相反：她的意思是不能乾等。

choices.t: The restaurant should close for lunch.
choices.zh: 餐廳午餐應該休息不營業。
choices.why: 後面是調整菜單繼續營業，沒有要關門。

choices.t: She does not believe the supplier called.
choices.zh: 她不相信供應商打過電話。
choices.why: 她詢問晚多久，並未質疑來電。

q.t: Look at the graphic. When will the seafood most likely arrive?
q.zh: 請看圖表。海鮮最可能何時送到？

choices.why: 正解：Ocean Fresh 平常 9:00，晚三小時就是 12:00。
這是平常送貨時間，今天延遲了。
這是 Valley Dairy 的送貨時間，並非海鮮。
這是午餐開始時間，不是到貨時間。

q.t: What does the man imply about the kitchen?
q.zh: 關於廚房，男士暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It has enough chicken for a new dish.
choices.zh: 有足夠的雞肉可做新菜。
choices.why: 正解：冷凍庫裡有很多雞肉。

choices.t: It can no longer serve any fish dishes.
choices.zh: 再也無法供應任何魚類料理。
choices.why: 只是今天海鮮延遲，並非永遠不能供應。

choices.t: It will order extra seafood tomorrow.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到明天的訂單。
只提到貨車故障，沒有說要換供應商。

level.why: 補償方式由重做改為免單，需聽出原因與言外之意，並推論廚房流程的問題。

dialogue.t: Excuse me, Mr. Lee at Table Six says his steak arrived cold.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，六號桌的李先生說他的牛排送來是冷的。

dialogue.t: That's strange. Did he say how long it sat before he ate it?
dialogue.zh: 奇怪了。他有說牛排放了多久才吃嗎？

dialogue.t: About fifteen minutes, because his guest's meal came out much later.
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，因為他同伴的餐點晚很多才出來。

dialogue.t: That explains it. The steak was ready first, but the fish took longer.
dialogue.zh: 這就說得通了。牛排先好，但魚花的時間比較久。

dialogue.t: Let's remake it for him at once, and offer a free dessert for the delay.
dialogue.zh: 我們馬上重做一份給他，並為延誤招待免費甜點。

dialogue.t: Actually, he has a train to catch in half an hour.
dialogue.zh: 其實他半小時後要趕火車。

dialogue.t: In that case, let's take the steak off his bill and apologize in person.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話，我們把牛排從帳單上扣掉，並當面道歉。

dialogue.t: Should I wrap the fish for his guest so they can take it with them?
dialogue.zh: 我要把魚打包給他同伴帶走嗎？

dialogue.t: I'll ask them first. They might prefer to finish eating before leaving.
dialogue.zh: 我先問問他們。他們可能比較想吃完再走。

dialogue.t: Good point. I'll go to the table now and explain the new arrangement.
dialogue.zh: 說得好。我現在就去桌邊說明新的安排。

dialogue.t: And I'll tell the kitchen to send out each table's dishes together from now on.
dialogue.zh: 我也會請廚房從現在起把每桌的餐點一起出。

q.t: What caused the steak to get cold?
q.zh: 是什麼造成牛排變冷？

choices.t: A companion's dish was served later.
choices.why: 正解：同伴的餐點晚很多才出來，牛排放涼了。

choices.t: The steak took thirty minutes to cook.
choices.zh: 牛排花了三十分鐘烹煮。
choices.why: 牛排其實先做好；十五分鐘是放置時間，半小時是火車時間。

choices.t: The server delivered it to the wrong table.
choices.why: 沒有這樣的說法，是等同伴的餐點。

choices.t: The kitchen ran out of fish.
choices.why: 魚只是花較久時間，沒有賣完。

q.t: What does the woman imply when she says, "he has a train to catch in half an hour"?
q.zh: 女士說「他半小時後要趕火車」暗示什麼？

choices.t: Making a new steak would take too long.
choices.why: 正解：因此經理改為免單與道歉。

choices.t: Mr. Lee wants to cancel the whole meal.
choices.why: 沒有這樣的意思，只是沒時間等。

choices.t: The manager should hurry to the station.
choices.why: 趕火車的是李先生，不是經理。

choices.t: The fish should be served first.
choices.why: 魚已經上了，問題在牛排放涼。

q.t: What can be inferred about the kitchen's current practice?
q.zh: 關於廚房目前的做法，可推論出什麼？

choices.t: Dishes for one table are not always sent out together.
choices.zh: 同一桌的餐點不一定一起出。
choices.why: 正解：從現在起要一起出，代表之前沒做到。

choices.t: Steaks always cook slower than fish.
choices.why: 相反：這次是牛排先好、魚較慢。

choices.t: Customers are never told about delays.
choices.zh: 客人從不會被告知延誤。
choices.why: 經理還要當面說明並道歉，無法得出這結論。

choices.t: The restaurant will stop serving fish.
choices.why: 只是調整出餐方式，沒有停售。

level.why: 兩人短對話，答案幾乎照字面出現，情境是常見的換貨。

dialogue.t: Hi, I bought these shoes yesterday, but they're too small.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我昨天買了這雙鞋，但是太小了。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you still have the box?
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾聽到這件事。你還留著鞋盒嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I have the box right here in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 有，鞋盒就在我的袋子裡。

dialogue.t: Great. Would you like a bigger size or your money back?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你想要大一點的尺寸，還是退錢？

dialogue.t: I'd like a size eight, please. These are size seven.
dialogue.zh: 我想要八號，麻煩你。這雙是七號。

dialogue.t: Let me check the stockroom. I'll be back in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我去倉庫看看。兩分鐘後回來。

dialogue.t: Thank you. I'll look at the socks while I wait.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我等的時候去看看襪子。

q.t: Why is the woman at the store?
q.zh: 女士為什麼在店裡？

choices.why: 正解：對話第一句 they're too small。

choices.t: She wants to buy some socks.
choices.why: 襪子是她等待時才要看的，不是來店裡的原因。

choices.t: She wants to pay for her shoes.
choices.why: 鞋子昨天就買了。
相反：鞋子太小。

q.t: What size does the woman want?
q.zh: 女士想要幾號？

choices.why: 正解：I'd like a size eight。
這是她現在這雙的尺寸。
對話沒有提到九號。
相反：她要大一點的尺寸。

q.t: What can be inferred about the store?
q.zh: 關於這家店，可推論出什麼？

choices.t: It keeps extra shoes in a back room.
choices.zh: 它把多的鞋子放在後面的倉庫。
choices.why: 正解：店員說要去 stockroom 查看。
沒有任何打烊的線索。
相反：女士說要去看襪子。

choices.t: It has no size eight shoes.
choices.why: 店員只是去查，沒有說賣完。

level.why: 對話以同義換句呈現缺貨與調貨流程，且需由言談推論顧客的急迫性。

dialogue.t: Hello, I'm looking for the Aero cordless vacuum, but the shelf is empty.
dialogue.zh: 哈囉，我在找 Aero 無線吸塵器，但貨架上是空的。

dialogue.t: I'm afraid we sold the last one this morning. It's been selling quickly since the ad came out.
dialogue.zh: 恐怕最後一台今天早上賣掉了。自從廣告推出後，它賣得很快。

dialogue.t: That's a shame. Do you know when more units will arrive?
dialogue.zh: 真可惜。你知道什麼時候會有更多貨到嗎？

dialogue.t: Our warehouse ships on Thursday, but I can check whether the downtown branch has one in stock.
dialogue.zh: 我們的倉庫週四出貨，不過我可以查一下市區分店有沒有現貨。

dialogue.t: Please do. I'd rather not wait a week, because my old vacuum broke yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。我不想等一週，因為我的舊吸塵器昨天壞了。

dialogue.t: Good news, they have two left. I can have one transferred here by tomorrow afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 好消息，他們還剩兩台。我可以安排明天下午前調一台過來。

dialogue.t: That works for me. Should I pay now, or when I pick it up?
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以。我該現在付款，還是取貨時再付？

dialogue.t: You can pay when it arrives. I just need your phone number so we can notify you.
dialogue.zh: 您可以在到貨時付款。我只需要您的電話號碼，好通知您。

q.t: What problem does the woman have?
q.zh: 這位女士遇到什麼問題？

choices.t: A product she wants is not available.
choices.why: 貨架是空的，最後一台已賣出。
舊吸塵器壞了有提到，但她來店裡遇到的問題是商品缺貨。

choices.t: New stock will not arrive until next week.
choices.why: 週四出貨、她不想等一週，並未說到貨要下週。

choices.t: The downtown branch has no stock.
choices.why: 分店還剩兩台。

q.t: What does the woman imply when she mentions her old vacuum?
q.zh: 這位女士提到舊吸塵器時暗示了什麼？

choices.t: She needs a new one soon.
choices.zh: 她很快就需要一台新的。
choices.why: 舊的昨天壞了，所以她不想等一週。

choices.t: She plans to repair it instead.
choices.why: 對話中沒有提到修理。

choices.t: She is willing to wait for the Thursday shipment.
choices.why: 她說不想等一週。

choices.t: She bought it at the downtown branch.
choices.why: 市區分店是男子提到的調貨來源，與舊吸塵器無關。

q.t: How will the woman get the vacuum?
q.zh: 這位女士要如何拿到吸塵器？

choices.t: It will be moved from another location.
choices.zh: 會從另一個據點調過來。
choices.why: 男子說可以從分店調一台過來。

choices.t: It will be sent from the warehouse on Thursday.
choices.why: 週四是倉庫出貨日，不是她取得商品的方式。

choices.t: She will drive to the downtown branch tonight.
choices.zh: 她今晚會開車去市區分店。
choices.why: 是由店員安排調貨，她在店裡取貨。

choices.t: The man will order a different model for her.
choices.zh: 男子會幫她訂不同的型號。
choices.why: 調的是同一款吸塵器。

level.why: 三人對話先選最便宜機種、再因容量與到貨時間改選，且需結合圖表與預算才能判斷最終機種。

dialogue.t: Good afternoon. Are you two shopping for a washing machine today?
dialogue.zh: 午安。兩位今天是來選購洗衣機的嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, our old one died last week. We were thinking of the cheapest model on your sale table.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們的舊洗衣機上週壞了。我們原本想買特價桌上最便宜的機種。

dialogue.t: Right, but with three kids, I'm not sure seven kilograms will be enough for us.
dialogue.zh: 對，不過家裡有三個孩子，我不確定七公斤夠不夠用。

dialogue.t: That's a fair concern. Most families your size choose at least nine kilograms.
dialogue.zh: 這個顧慮很合理。像你們這種人數的家庭，大多至少選九公斤。

dialogue.t: Then let's consider the nine-kilogram one. How soon could you bring it to our house?
dialogue.zh: 那我們考慮九公斤的那台。你們多快能送到我們家？

dialogue.t: That model takes five days, I'm afraid. Is that too long for you?
dialogue.zh: 那個機種恐怕要五天。這對你們來說太久嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, we have a lot of laundry, and we'd like it within three days.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們有很多衣服要洗，希望三天內送到。

dialogue.t: Hmm, what about the ten-kilogram model? It's more expensive, but it would arrive on time.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，十公斤的機種呢？它比較貴，但可以準時到。

dialogue.t: Exactly. It costs about a hundred and fifty dollars more than the nine-kilogram one.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。它比九公斤的那台貴大約一百五十元。

dialogue.t: That's acceptable. Our budget is seven hundred dollars, so we can afford it.
dialogue.zh: 這可以接受。我們的預算是七百元，所以負擔得起。

dialogue.t: Then it's decided. We'll take the ten-kilogram model.
dialogue.zh: 那就決定了。我們買十公斤的機種。

dialogue.t: Wonderful. I'll prepare the paperwork while you two finish looking around the store.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你們兩位繼續逛逛，我來準備文件。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Choosing a new appliance for a household
choices.why: 舊洗衣機壞了，他們在挑選新的洗衣機。
舊機器壞了只是背景，對話是在買新的。
到貨時間只是選機種的條件之一。

choices.t: Returning a damaged item to the store
choices.zh: 把損壞的商品退回店裡
choices.why: 沒有任何退貨的內容。

q.t: What does the man imply about his family?
q.zh: 男子對他的家人暗示了什麼？

choices.t: It produces a large amount of laundry.
choices.why: 他提到有三個孩子，擔心七公斤不夠用。

choices.t: It wants the cheapest machine available.
choices.zh: 家裡想要最便宜的機器。
choices.why: 最便宜是原本的想法，男子擔心容量不足，後來改選較貴的機種。

choices.t: It plans to move to a new house soon.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到搬家，只說送到現在的家。

choices.t: It has just bought a new dryer.
choices.zh: 家裡剛買了新的烘衣機。
choices.why: 對話中沒有人提到買烘衣機。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which model will the speakers most likely buy?
q.zh: 請看圖表。說話者最可能買哪一款？

choices.why: 10 公斤、三天到貨、$690，符合三天內到貨與七百元預算。
這是原本想買的最便宜機種，但七公斤容量不夠。
九公斤要五天才到，超過他們要求的三天。
12 公斤要七天且 $820 超出預算。

level.why: 兩人短對話，需用圖表的顏色與價格配合對話挑出商品。

dialogue.t: Can I help you find something today?
dialogue.zh: 需要我幫你找什麼東西嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I'm looking for a backpack for school.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我想找一個上學用的背包。

dialogue.t: We have several. Do you have a color in mind?
dialogue.zh: 我們有好幾款。你有想要的顏色嗎？

dialogue.t: I'd like a blue one, and I can spend up to forty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我想要藍色的，而且最多可以花四十美元。

dialogue.t: Backpack A is blue and very new, but it costs fifty-five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 背包 A 是藍色又很新，但要五十五美元。

dialogue.t: That's a little more than I planned to spend.
dialogue.zh: 這比我打算花的錢多一點。

dialogue.t: I understand. Please look at the other blue bag on our list.
dialogue.zh: 我了解。請看看我們清單上另一個藍色的包。

dialogue.t: Okay, I'll go and see the other bag now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就去看另一個包。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "That's a little more than I planned to spend"?
q.zh: 女士說「這比我打算花的錢多一點」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The bag costs more than she wants to pay.
choices.zh: 這個包的價錢超過她想付的。
choices.why: 正解：背包 A 要 55 美元，她最多只想花 40 美元。

choices.t: She wants to buy two bags.
choices.why: 沒有提到要買兩個。

choices.t: She likes the bag very much.
choices.why: 相反：她覺得太貴。

choices.t: She plans to spend fifty-five dollars.
choices.why: 五十五美元是價格，她的預算是四十美元。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which backpack will the woman probably buy?
q.zh: 請看圖表。女士最可能買哪一個背包？

choices.why: 正解：藍色且 $35，符合顏色與四十美元預算。
藍色但 $55，超過預算。
價格符合，但是黑色，她要藍色。
價格符合，但是綠色，她要藍色。

q.t: What will the woman do next?
q.zh: 女士接下來會做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：I'll go and see the other bag now。
她覺得背包 A 太貴。
她說要去看另一個包，沒有要離開。

choices.t: Ask the man for a refund
choices.why: 她還沒買任何東西。

level.why: 需結合圖表中的規格與價格，再配合對話中的條件與語意判斷。

dialogue.t: I travel often for work, so I need a laptop whose battery lasts at least ten hours.
dialogue.zh: 我常因公出差，所以需要電池至少能撐十小時的筆電。

dialogue.t: Then you'll like our sale models. May I ask what your price limit is?
dialogue.zh: 那您會喜歡我們的特價機種。請問您的預算上限是多少？

dialogue.t: Nine hundred dollars at most, and I want a screen larger than thirteen inches.
dialogue.zh: 最多九百元，而且我想要大於十三吋的螢幕。

dialogue.t: I see. Our best-selling model has the longest battery life, but it costs more than that.
dialogue.zh: 了解。我們最暢銷的機種電池續航最久，不過價格比那高。

dialogue.t: Well, I'd rather not pay extra for features I won't use.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我不想為用不到的功能多付錢。

dialogue.t: Understood. There's one model that matches everything you've told me.
dialogue.zh: 了解。有一款符合您所說的所有條件。

dialogue.t: Great. Does it come with a carrying case, or is that sold separately?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。它有附攜帶保護套，還是要另外購買？

dialogue.t: A case is included. Let me get one from the back so you can try it.
dialogue.zh: 有附保護套。我去後面拿一台來讓您試用。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which laptop will the woman most likely buy?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這位女士最可能買哪一台筆電？

choices.why: 14 吋、續航 10 小時、$690，符合所有條件。
續航與價格符合，但螢幕只有 13 吋，不大於十三吋。
續航只有 9 小時，不到十小時。
這是男子提到最暢銷的機種，但 $1,050 超出預算。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather not pay extra for features I won't use"?
q.zh: 女士說「I'd rather not pay extra for features I won't use」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She prefers a simpler, less expensive model.
choices.zh: 她偏好較簡單、較便宜的機種。
choices.why: 她拒絕為用不到的功能加價，等於不選較貴的機種。

choices.t: She wants the model with the longest battery life.
choices.zh: 她想要電池續航最久的機種。
choices.why: 續航最久的機種較貴，她不想多付錢。

choices.t: She has already chosen a laptop.
choices.why: 之後男子才說有一款符合條件，她尚未選定。

choices.t: She thinks all the sale prices are too high.
choices.zh: 她覺得所有特價價格都太高。
choices.why: 她只是不想為多餘功能加價，並非批評所有價格。

q.t: What will the man most likely do next?
q.zh: 男子接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Bring a laptop for the woman to test
choices.zh: 拿一台筆電給女士試用
choices.why: 他說要去後面拿一台讓她試用。
保護套已隨機附贈。

choices.t: Show her a price list on the Internet
choices.zh: 給她看網路上的價目表
choices.why: 價格資訊在圖表上，對話中並未提到上網查詢。
他要從店內後方拿貨，沒有提到其他分店。

level.why: 顧客先堅持退款、後改為換新款，並需理解主管話語的言外之意與後續動作。

dialogue.t: Hi, I bought this coffee maker two weeks ago, and the lid already cracked.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我兩週前買了這台咖啡機，蓋子已經裂了。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the proof of purchase with you?
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾聽到這件事。您有帶購買證明嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, it's in my bag. Honestly, I'd like my money back, because I don't trust this brand anymore.
dialogue.zh: 有，在我的包包裡。老實說，我想退錢，因為我不再信任這個品牌了。

dialogue.t: Refunds need a manager's approval, so let me call Ms. Carter over.
dialogue.zh: 退款需要經理核准，我請 Carter 女士過來。

dialogue.t: Hello, sir. I'm Ms. Carter. Could you show me where the lid cracked?
dialogue.zh: 您好，先生。我是 Carter。可以讓我看看蓋子裂在哪裡嗎？

dialogue.t: Right here along the edge. It happened the first time I washed it.
dialogue.zh: 就在這邊的邊緣。我第一次清洗它的時候就裂了。

dialogue.t: That's clearly a manufacturing flaw. We can give you a refund, but we also have a newer model in stock.
dialogue.zh: 這顯然是製造瑕疵。我們可以退款給您，不過我們也有較新的機種有現貨。

dialogue.t: Does the newer one cost more? I don't want to pay extra.
dialogue.zh: 新的比較貴嗎？我不想多付錢。

dialogue.t: It's twenty dollars higher, but we'll cover the difference because of the trouble.
dialogue.zh: 它高二十元，但為了這次的麻煩，差額由我們負擔。

dialogue.t: In that case, I'll take the new model instead of the refund.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話，我要新機種，不要退款了。

dialogue.t: Great. I'll get one from the shelf and bring it to the register while you sign the form.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。您簽表格的時候，我去架上拿一台，帶到收銀台。

q.t: Why does the man first ask for his money back?
q.zh: 男子一開始為什麼要求退錢？

choices.t: He has lost confidence in the brand.
choices.zh: 他對這個品牌失去信心。
choices.why: 他說不再信任這個品牌。

choices.t: The lid cracked after two weeks.
choices.why: 這是商品的問題，但他要求退錢的理由是不再信任品牌。

choices.t: He lost his proof of purchase.
choices.why: 他說購買證明在包包裡。

choices.t: The manager asked him to request one.
choices.why: 是男子自己提出退款，經理是之後才出現。

q.t: What does the manager mean when she says, "That's clearly a manufacturing flaw"?
q.zh: 經理說「That's clearly a manufacturing flaw」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The damage was not caused by the customer.
choices.why: 製造瑕疵代表問題出在產品本身。

choices.t: The customer must pay for the repair.
choices.why: 後來店家還願意負擔差額。

choices.t: The coffee maker is no longer sold.
choices.why: 她只說有較新的機種有現貨，沒有說舊款停售。

choices.t: The product was made two weeks ago.
choices.zh: 這個產品是兩週前製造的。
choices.why: 兩週前是男子購買的時間，不是製造時間。

q.t: What will the clerk probably do next?
q.zh: 店員接下來可能會做什麼？

choices.t: Get a new coffee maker for the man
choices.zh: 幫男子拿一台新咖啡機
choices.why: 他說要從架上拿一台帶到收銀台。

choices.t: Give the man his money back
choices.why: 男子已改選新機種，不要退款。

choices.t: Call the manager to the counter
choices.why: 經理已經來了，這件事已完成。

choices.t: Fill out the form for the man
choices.why: 是男子要簽表格，店員去拿商品。

level.why: 兩人對話僅 8 句，用語簡單，三題答案幾乎都能在對話中直接找到。

dialogue.t: Hi, I'd like to buy this blue scarf as a birthday gift for my sister.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想買這條藍色圍巾當作送給我妹妹的生日禮物。

dialogue.t: It's a lovely choice. It costs thirty dollars, and it comes in two other colors.
dialogue.zh: 這選擇很棒。它要三十元，另外還有兩種顏色。

dialogue.t: Thanks, but blue is her favorite. Can you wrap it for me?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，不過藍色是她最愛的顏色。你可以幫我包起來嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. Gift wrapping is free if you spend over twenty-five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。消費超過二十五元的話，禮品包裝是免費的。

dialogue.t: Great. Her party is tomorrow, so I need it ready in about ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。她的派對是明天，所以我需要在大約十分鐘內拿到。

dialogue.t: No problem. Please look around while I wrap it, and I'll call you at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我包裝的時候請隨意逛逛，我會在櫃檯叫您。

dialogue.t: Perfect. I'll go and look at the hats over there.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我去看看那邊的帽子。

dialogue.t: Sure. Those are on sale this week, too.
dialogue.zh: 好的。那些帽子這週也在特價。

q.t: Why does the woman visit the store?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼來到這家店？

choices.t: To buy a present for a family member
choices.why: 她說要買圍巾當作妹妹的生日禮物。

choices.t: To return a scarf she bought earlier
choices.why: 她是要購買圍巾，而不是退貨。

choices.t: To ask about a sale on hats
choices.why: 帽子特價是男子最後才提到，並非她來店的目的。

choices.t: To pick up an order for a party
choices.zh: 領取派對用的訂購商品
choices.why: 派對只是送禮的場合，她並非來取訂購品。

q.t: What does the man say is free for the woman?
q.zh: 男子說什麼對這位女士是免費的？

choices.why: 男子說消費超過二十五元，禮品包裝免費。
他只提到還有其他兩種顏色，並未說免費更換。
對話中沒有提到任何送貨服務。
帽子只是特價商品，並非免費贈品。

q.t: What will the woman most likely do while she waits?
q.zh: 這位女士等待時最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Browse other items in the store
choices.why: 店員請她隨意逛逛，她說要去看帽子。
她說藍色是妹妹的最愛，不會改選別色。

choices.t: Call her sister about the party
choices.why: 對話中沒有任何打電話給妹妹的跡象。
店員會在櫃檯叫她，但她說要先去看帽子。

level.why: 涉及點數規則的變更與金額換算，需用推論理解女士原本的誤解。

dialogue.t: Welcome to Greenfield Market. Are you a member of our rewards program?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨 Greenfield 超市。請問您是我們回饋計畫的會員嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, but I left my card at home. Can you look me up by phone number?
dialogue.zh: 是的，但我把卡片放在家裡了。你可以用電話號碼查我的資料嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. You have twelve hundred points, which is enough to cover fifteen dollars of today's purchase.
dialogue.zh: 當然。您有一千兩百點，足以折抵今天消費的十五元。

dialogue.t: Really? I thought points expired after one year, and mine are from last spring.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我以為點數一年後就會過期，而我的是去年春天的。

dialogue.t: They used to, but the company changed that policy in January, so yours are still valid.
dialogue.zh: 以前是這樣，但公司一月改了這項規定，所以您的點數仍然有效。

dialogue.t: That's a relief. Please apply them to this order.
dialogue.zh: 那我就放心了。請把它們用在這筆訂單上。

dialogue.t: Done. Your total is now twenty-two dollars, and you'll earn new points on that amount.
dialogue.zh: 好了。您現在的總額是二十二元，而且這筆金額會累積新的點數。

dialogue.t: Wonderful. I'll make sure to bring my card next time.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我下次一定會帶卡片。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Using reward points for a purchase
choices.zh: 使用回饋點數支付購物
choices.why: 全段圍繞查詢並使用點數折抵消費。
卡片只是放在家裡，並非遺失，也沒有討論補發。

choices.t: Signing up for the rewards program
choices.why: 女士已經是會員。

choices.t: Returning an item she bought last spring
choices.zh: 退還去年春天買的商品
choices.why: 去年春天是指點數的取得時間，沒有退貨。

q.t: How much of the woman's bill can her points cover?
q.zh: 女士的點數可以折抵帳單多少錢？

choices.why: 男子說點數足以折抵十五元。
一千兩百是點數，不是金額。
二十二元是折抵後的應付總額。
折抵後她還需支付二十二元。

q.t: What does the woman imply about her points?
q.zh: 女士對她的點數暗示了什麼？

choices.t: She was unaware of a policy change.
choices.why: 她以為點數一年會過期，男子說一月已改規定。

choices.t: She earned them only this week.
choices.zh: 她這週才剛賺到這些點數。
choices.why: 她說點數是去年春天的。

choices.t: She received them from a friend.
choices.zh: 她是從朋友那裡拿到的。
choices.why: 對話中沒有提到朋友。
她反而要求把點數用在訂單上。

items.tag: 訂購書桌並決定自行組裝

level.why: 顧客先要求組裝服務、後改為自己組裝，並需加總金額與推論友人的能力。

dialogue.t: I'd like to order this oak desk for my home office, and I want your staff to assemble it.
dialogue.zh: 我想訂這張橡木書桌放在家庭辦公室，而且我要你們的員工幫忙組裝。

dialogue.t: Certainly. The desk is two hundred sixty dollars, and our assembly service costs another forty.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。書桌是兩百六十元，我們的組裝服務另外收四十元。

dialogue.t: Forty dollars just for putting it together? I built my own bookshelf in an hour.
dialogue.zh: 光是組裝就要四十元？我自己一小時就組好了我的書架。

dialogue.t: True, but you're good at that. I'm terrible with tools and instructions.
dialogue.zh: 是沒錯，但你很擅長這種事。我對工具和說明書很不行。

dialogue.t: I can help you this weekend, so you'd save the forty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 這個週末我可以幫你，這樣你就能省下四十元。

dialogue.t: Okay, you convinced me. We'll skip the assembly, but can the desk go to my third-floor apartment?
dialogue.zh: 好吧，你說服我了。我們不要組裝服務，但書桌可以送到我三樓的公寓嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, but our drivers charge a fifteen-dollar stairs fee, so your total will be two hundred seventy-five.
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過我們的司機會收十五元的樓梯費，所以您的總額是兩百七十五元。

dialogue.t: That's fine. Is there a Saturday morning slot, so my friend can be there?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。有週六早上的時段嗎？這樣我朋友就能在場。

dialogue.t: Saturday mornings are full, but I can put you down for two o'clock that afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 週六早上都滿了，不過我可以幫您排當天下午兩點。

dialogue.t: Two is fine with me. I'll bring my toolbox over around one.
dialogue.zh: 兩點我可以。我一點左右會帶著工具箱過去。

dialogue.t: Then please put me down for that time, and I'll pay the total at the register now.
dialogue.zh: 那就請幫我排那個時段，我現在就在收銀台付總額。

q.t: Where most likely are the speakers?
q.zh: 說話者最可能在哪裡？

choices.why: 女士在訂書桌，並討論組裝與配送。
工具箱只是朋友自己要帶的物品，店裡賣的是書桌。
配送與樓梯費只是購買書桌的附帶服務。
書桌是放在家庭辦公室，但店裡賣的是家具，且沒提到辦公用品。

q.t: What can be inferred about the man?
q.zh: 關於男子可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: He is skilled at putting furniture together.
choices.why: 他一小時就自己組好書架，女士也說他很擅長。
他是陪同顧客的朋友，並非員工。

choices.t: He plans to buy a bookshelf.
choices.why: 書架是他已經自己組好的東西。

choices.t: He thinks the desk is too expensive.
choices.why: 他嫌的是組裝費，不是書桌價格。

q.t: How much will the woman pay today?
q.zh: 這位女士今天要付多少錢？

choices.why: 店員說總額是兩百七十五元（書桌加樓梯費）。
這只是書桌價格，還要加上樓梯費。
這是書桌加組裝費，但她已經不要組裝服務。
把組裝費也算進去，但她已取消組裝。

level.why: 兩人短對話，月台、誤點時間與購票位置都幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Pardon me, which platform do I use for the airport train?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我要搭機場列車該去哪個月台？

dialogue.t: The airport train leaves from Platform 4, but it's a little late today.
dialogue.zh: 機場列車從 4 號月台出發，不過今天有點誤點。

dialogue.t: How late is it? My flight is at six o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 誤點多久？我的班機是六點。

dialogue.t: About fifteen minutes. It should arrive at four thirty.
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘。它應該四點半到。

dialogue.t: That's fine. I still have plenty of time. Where can I buy a ticket?
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。我時間還很充裕。我可以在哪裡買票？

dialogue.t: The ticket machines are near the main entrance, on your left.
dialogue.zh: 售票機在主要入口附近，在您的左手邊。

dialogue.t: Thank you. I'll buy one now and wait on the platform.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。我現在去買一張，然後在月台等。

dialogue.t: Good idea. Have a safe trip.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。祝您旅途平安。

q.t: Why does the woman talk to the man?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼找男子說話？

choices.t: To find out which platform to use
choices.why: 她一開始就問機場列車要用哪個月台。

choices.t: To buy a ticket for the airport
choices.why: 買票是之後才問的，不是她找他的主因。
她只提到班機是六點，沒有要更改。
誤點是男子告訴她的，不是她要回報的事。

q.t: How late is the airport train?
q.zh: 機場列車誤點多久？

choices.why: 男子說大約十五分鐘。
4 是月台號碼，不是誤點時間。
四點半是預計到站時間，不是誤點長度。
六點是班機時間。

q.t: What can be inferred about the woman?
q.zh: 關於這位女士可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: She has not bought a ticket yet.
choices.why: 她問哪裡可以買票，並說現在去買一張。

choices.t: She has already boarded the train.
choices.why: 她還在月台，列車尚未到站。
車站人員是男子。
她說還有很多時間。

level.why: 以同義換句說明路線維修與接駁方式，並需由月票的說明推論其涵蓋範圍。

dialogue.t: Is the Blue Line running normally this morning? I have to reach Harbor Station by nine.
dialogue.zh: 藍線今天早上正常行駛嗎？我九點前必須到達港口站。

dialogue.t: Not exactly. Because of track repairs, trains stop at Central, and shuttle buses cover the rest.
dialogue.zh: 不太正常。因為軌道維修，列車只到中央站，其餘路段由接駁巴士負責。

dialogue.t: How long does the shuttle take? I have an important appointment at nine thirty.
dialogue.zh: 接駁車要多久？我九點半有個重要的約。

dialogue.t: It adds roughly twenty minutes to the usual trip, so I'd leave right away.
dialogue.zh: 它會讓平常的行程多出大約二十分鐘，所以我建議您馬上出發。

dialogue.t: Where do I catch the shuttle? Is it inside the station?
dialogue.zh: 我要在哪裡搭接駁車？是在車站裡面嗎？

dialogue.t: No, it's outside Exit B, on the opposite side of the main road.
dialogue.zh: 不是，在 B 出口外面，主要道路的對面。

dialogue.t: Got it. Do I have to pay extra for it?
dialogue.zh: 了解。我需要另外付費嗎？

dialogue.t: Not at all. Just show your train pass to the driver.
dialogue.zh: 完全不用。只要把您的車票月票給司機看就好。

q.t: What is the woman asking about?
q.zh: 這位女士在詢問什麼？

choices.t: How to reach a station while service is disrupted
choices.zh: 在服務受影響時如何到達某個車站
choices.why: 她問藍線是否正常，並詢問接駁方式。

choices.t: When the repairs will be finished
choices.why: 維修只是原因，她關心的是如何準時抵達。

choices.t: Where to buy a train pass
choices.why: 月票是男子最後提到的，她沒有問購買。

choices.t: How to apply for a job
choices.why: 她只提到約會，不是求職。

q.t: How much longer will the trip take because of the shuttle?
q.zh: 因為接駁車，行程會多花多久？

choices.why: 男子說會多出大約二十分鐘。
九點半是她約會的時間。
九點是她必須抵達的時間。
男子說會多出時間，並建議馬上出發。

q.t: What can be inferred about the woman's train pass?
q.zh: 關於這位女士的車票月票可以推論出什麼？

choices.why: 她不用另外付費，只要給司機看月票。

choices.t: It cannot be used on buses.
choices.why: 司機接受月票，所以搭接駁巴士可以使用。
對話中沒有提到過期。

choices.t: She bought it from the driver.
choices.why: 司機只是查看月票，沒有提到販售。

level.why: 三人對話先選最便宜班次、再因會議時間改選，且需結合時刻表與現在時間才能判斷班次。

dialogue.t: We'd like two tickets to Eastgate on the cheapest train, please.
dialogue.zh: 我們想買兩張到 Eastgate 的票，搭最便宜的班次。

dialogue.t: It's two thirty now, and the cheapest train leaves at 3:30. Is that all right?
dialogue.zh: 現在是兩點半，最便宜的班次三點半開。這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.t: Hold on. Our meeting in Eastgate starts at 4:30, so we must arrive before then.
dialogue.zh: 等一下。我們在 Eastgate 的會議四點半開始，所以必須在那之前到。

dialogue.t: Right. The cheapest train won't work, then, will it?
dialogue.zh: 對。這樣最便宜的班次就不行了，對吧？

dialogue.t: No, it arrives at 5:20. The 2:10 train would have worked, but it already left.
dialogue.zh: 不行，它五點二十分才到。兩點十分那班本來可以，但已經開走了。

dialogue.t: So what's our best choice from here?
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在最好的選擇是什麼？

dialogue.t: The 2:50 train is the only one that gets you there in time, and it costs $45.
dialogue.zh: 兩點五十分那班是唯一能讓你們準時到的，票價是四十五元。

dialogue.t: That's more than we expected, but the meeting matters more. We'll take it.
dialogue.zh: 這比我們預期的貴，但會議更重要。我們就搭那班。

dialogue.t: Is the gate far from here? We don't want to miss it.
dialogue.zh: 閘口離這裡遠嗎？我們不想錯過它。

dialogue.t: Gate 6 is straight ahead, so you have plenty of time.
dialogue.zh: 6 號閘口就在正前方，所以你們時間很充裕。

dialogue.t: Thanks. We'll pay by card, if that's all right.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我們想刷卡付款，可以嗎？

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Finding a train that fits their meeting time
choices.zh: 找一班配合他們會議時間的火車
choices.why: 最便宜的班次趕不上會議，所以重新選班次。

choices.t: Changing a ticket they already bought
choices.why: 他們是在買票，尚未買過。

choices.t: Finding the way to the gate
choices.why: 閘口只是之後順帶問的小事。

choices.t: Choosing how to pay for tickets
choices.why: 付款方式只在最後一句提到。

q.t: What can be inferred about the 2:10 train?
q.zh: 關於兩點十分那班火車可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It would have arrived in time but has departed.
choices.zh: 它本來能準時到，但已經開走了。
choices.why: 售票員說它本來可以，但已經離開。
最便宜的是三點半那班。

choices.t: It arrives after the meeting begins.
choices.why: 售票員說它本來可以趕上。
原因是已開走，而不是賣完。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which train will the speakers most likely take?
q.zh: 請看圖表。說話者最可能搭哪一班火車？

choices.why: 兩點五十分開、四點零五分到，票價 $45，是現在唯一能趕上會議的班次。
兩點十分那班已經開走。
這是最便宜的班次，但五點二十分才到。
五點三十分才到，遠超過會議時間。

level.why: 兩人短對話，搭配簡單時刻表，只需對照現在時間與發車時間即可。

dialogue.t: Sorry to bother you, but do you know which bus goes to the Central Library?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思打擾，你知道哪一路公車到中央圖書館嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, it's Route 31. The timetable is on the pole behind you.
dialogue.zh: 知道，是 31 路。時刻表在你後面的柱子上。

dialogue.t: Thanks. It's ten thirty now, and I have a meeting at noon.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。現在是十點半，而我中午有個會議。

dialogue.t: Don't worry, you'll make it. The ride only takes about twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，你趕得上。車程只要大約二十分鐘。

dialogue.t: Great. Do I pay the driver, or should I buy a ticket here?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我是付給司機，還是要在這裡買票？

dialogue.t: You can pay the driver. The fare is on the board, and exact change is best.
dialogue.zh: 您可以付給司機。車資寫在看板上，最好準備剛好的零錢。

dialogue.t: I only have large bills. Is there a shop nearby where I can get coins?
dialogue.zh: 我只有大鈔。附近有店可以換到硬幣嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, the café across the street can help you.
dialogue.zh: 有，對面的咖啡店可以幫你。

graphic.title: Bus Timetable at Oak Street Stop

q.t: Look at the graphic. How long will the woman wait for her bus?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這位女士要等多久才有她要搭的公車？

choices.why: 她要搭 31 路，十點四十發車；現在是十點半，所以等十分鐘。
二十分鐘是車程，不是等車時間。
十一點零五分是 48 路的發車時間，不是她要搭的車。
十點二十五分是 25 路的發車時間，且已經過了。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "Don't worry, you'll make it"?
q.zh: 男子說「Don't worry, you'll make it」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She will arrive before her meeting.
choices.why: 她擔心中午的會議，他說車程只要二十分鐘。
他是要讓她放心，沒有提到圖書館關閉。

choices.t: The bus ride is very long.
choices.why: 他說車程只要約二十分鐘。

choices.t: She should take a taxi instead.
choices.why: 他建議搭公車，沒有提到計程車。

q.t: What will the woman probably do next?
q.zh: 這位女士接下來可能會做什麼？

choices.t: Get coins at a nearby café
choices.zh: 去附近的咖啡店換零錢
choices.why: 她只有大鈔，男子說對面咖啡店可以幫她。

choices.t: Pay the driver with a large bill
choices.why: 男子建議準備剛好的零錢，她也想換硬幣。

choices.t: Buy a ticket at the bus stop
choices.why: 她問過在這裡買票，但男子說付給司機即可。
對話中沒有提到打電話。

items.tag: 比較前往會場的交通方式

level.why: 需結合圖表中的時間與費用，再依現在時間與預算條件挑出最合適的選項。

dialogue.t: The event starts at two o'clock, and it's already one thirty. How should we get to Lakeside Hall?
dialogue.zh: 活動兩點開始，而現在已經一點半了。我們該怎麼去 Lakeside Hall？

dialogue.t: Walking takes too long. I'd say we take a taxi, even though it costs more.
dialogue.zh: 走路太久了。我想我們搭計程車，雖然比較貴。

dialogue.t: Well, I'm trying to keep today's costs down.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我今天想盡量控制開銷。

dialogue.t: But we can't be late. The organizer said the doors close ten minutes after the start.
dialogue.zh: 但我們不能遲到。主辦單位說活動開始十分鐘後就會關門。

dialogue.t: True. Is there anything quick that doesn't cost a lot?
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。有沒有什麼又快又不貴的方式？

dialogue.t: Let me check the app. There's a subway route and a bus, and both are cheaper than a taxi.
dialogue.zh: 我來看一下應用程式。有地鐵路線和公車，兩者都比計程車便宜。

dialogue.t: Then let's take the cheapest option that still gets us there before two.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就選最便宜、而且還能在兩點前到的方式。

dialogue.t: Okay, I'll buy the tickets from the machine right now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就去售票機買票。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'm trying to keep today's costs down"?
q.zh: 女士說「I'm trying to keep today's costs down」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She prefers a less expensive way to travel.
choices.zh: 她偏好比較便宜的交通方式。
choices.why: 這是在回應男子建議搭較貴的計程車。

choices.t: She wants to walk to the hall.
choices.why: 走路雖然免費，但太久，她也問有沒有快的方式。

choices.t: She forgot her wallet at the office.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到忘記錢包。

choices.t: She is unsure when the event begins.
choices.zh: 她不確定活動何時開始。
choices.why: 她一開始就說活動兩點開始。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which option will the speakers most likely choose?
q.zh: 請看圖表。說話者最可能選哪個選項？

choices.why: 現在一點半，25 分鐘可在兩點前到，且 $2 是能準時抵達的選項中最便宜的。
雖然免費，但要 40 分鐘，會超過兩點。
能準時到，但 $3 不是最便宜的。
這是男子一開始的建議，但費用最高，被女士否決。

q.t: What will the man probably do next?
q.zh: 男子接下來可能會做什麼？

choices.why: 他說現在就去售票機買票。
他們決定搭較便宜的方式。

choices.t: Ask the organizer about the doors
choices.zh: 向主辦單位詢問關門時間
choices.why: 關門時間是主辦單位已說過的，不需再問。
走路太久，已被排除。

level.why: 駕駛先打算自行修理、後因技師說明改為拖吊，需理解言外之意與後續行動。

dialogue.t: My car just stopped in the middle of the road, and the engine won't turn over.
dialogue.zh: 我的車剛剛在路中間熄火了，引擎發不動。

dialogue.t: Please steer to the curb first. You're blocking the right lane, and traffic is building up.
dialogue.zh: 請先把車開到路邊。你擋住右側車道了，車流越來越塞。

dialogue.t: I will. My brother is on his way with a spare part, so I'll wait here and fix it myself.
dialogue.zh: 好。我哥哥帶著備用零件正在趕來，所以我會在這裡等，自己修。

dialogue.t: I can't let you stay here for long. This street is a no-parking zone after four o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 我不能讓你在這裡待太久。這條街四點後禁止停車。

dialogue.t: Excuse me, I'm a mechanic. I heard what you said. It sounds like a starter problem, which takes hours to repair.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我是技師。我聽到你說的了。聽起來像是啟動馬達的問題，要花好幾個小時修。

dialogue.t: Hours? My brother only expected a quick fix of about twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好幾個小時？我哥哥原本只預期大約二十分鐘就能修好。

dialogue.t: Not for this problem. You'd be better off having the car towed to a garage.
dialogue.zh: 這個問題不是。你最好把車拖到修車廠。

dialogue.t: I agree. I can call a tow truck now, and it should arrive within fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我同意。我現在可以叫拖吊車，大約十五分鐘內會到。

dialogue.t: All right, please do that. I'll let my brother know not to come.
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩你。我會告訴我哥哥不用來了。

dialogue.t: There's a garage on Pine Avenue that I'd recommend. Tell them Dave sent you.
dialogue.zh: 我推薦 Pine 大道上有一家修車廠。跟他們說是 Dave 介紹的。

dialogue.t: Thanks, I'll give them a call as soon as the tow truck leaves.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，拖吊車一離開我就打電話給他們。

q.t: What does the driver originally plan to do?
q.zh: 駕駛原本打算做什麼？

choices.t: Wait for his brother and repair the car himself
choices.why: 他說哥哥帶零件來，他會在這裡等並自己修。

choices.t: Call a tow truck right away
choices.why: 叫拖吊車是之後警察提出的做法。

choices.t: Ask the mechanic to fix it
choices.why: 技師是主動插話，駕駛原本沒有這個打算。

choices.t: Push the car to a garage
choices.why: 對話中沒有提到推車去修車廠。

q.t: What does the mechanic mean when he says, "Not for this problem"?
q.zh: 技師說「Not for this problem」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The repair will take much longer than expected.
choices.zh: 修理會比預期花更久的時間。
choices.why: 這是回應二十分鐘就能修好的說法，他前面說要好幾個小時。

choices.t: The problem is easy to fix.
choices.why: 他說這需要好幾個小時。
技師沒有談到哥哥能不能來。
他說自己是技師，只是在說明這個問題的修理時間。

q.t: What will the driver do once the tow truck leaves?
q.zh: 拖吊車離開後，駕駛會做什麼？

choices.why: 他說拖吊車一離開就打電話給那家修車廠。

choices.t: Wait for his brother to arrive
choices.why: 他說要告訴哥哥不用來了。

choices.t: Drive the car to the curb
choices.why: 開到路邊是對話一開始警察的要求。
是警察要打電話叫拖吊車，不是駕駛。

level.why: 兩人短對話，停車位置、時間限制與費用幾乎照字面出現，推論題只需比對一小時與兩小時。

dialogue.t: Officer, is it okay to leave my car on this street for an hour?
dialogue.zh: 警官，我可以把車停在這條街上一小時嗎？

dialogue.t: Not on this side. Parking is allowed only on the north side of the street.
dialogue.zh: 這一側不行。只有街道北側可以停車。

dialogue.t: I see. Is there a sign that shows the time limit?
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。有標示時間限制的牌子嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, the sign says two hours, from nine in the morning until six.
dialogue.zh: 有，牌子上寫兩小時，從早上九點到六點。

dialogue.t: Good. I only need one hour to visit the bank.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我去銀行只需要一小時。

dialogue.t: Then park across the road, and be sure to pay at the meter.
dialogue.zh: 那就停到對面，記得要在停車計時器付費。

dialogue.t: How much is it? I only have a few coins.
dialogue.zh: 要多少錢？我只有幾個硬幣。

dialogue.t: One dollar per hour. The meter takes both coins and cards.
dialogue.zh: 每小時一元。計時器可以用硬幣也可以刷卡。

q.t: What does the man ask about?
q.zh: 男子在詢問什麼？

choices.t: Whether he can park on the street
choices.zh: 他能不能把車停在街上
choices.why: 他一開始就問能不能把車停在這條街上一小時。

choices.t: How to get to the bank
choices.why: 銀行只是他停車的原因。

choices.t: How to pay a parking fine
choices.why: 對話中沒有罰單。
他說有幾個硬幣，且計時器也可刷卡。

q.t: What is the parking time limit?
q.zh: 停車的時間限制是多久？

choices.why: 警察說牌子上寫兩小時。
一小時是男子需要的停車時間。
六點是限制時段的結束時間。
九點是限制時段的開始時間。

q.t: What can be inferred about the man's parking?
q.zh: 關於男子的停車可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: He will stay within the time limit.
choices.why: 他只需要一小時，限制是兩小時。

choices.t: He needs more than two hours.
choices.why: 他說只需要一小時。

choices.t: He plans to park on the same side.
choices.why: 警察要他停到對面。
他只說要去銀行，沒說在那裡工作。

level.why: 以同義換句說明車款缺貨與價差，並需由路線描述推論女士的需求。

dialogue.t: Are there any bikes left to rent for the afternoon? I'd like to ride along the river.
dialogue.zh: 還有可以租一個下午的自行車嗎？我想沿著河邊騎。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry, all of our city bikes are out, but we still have two electric ones.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，我們的城市自行車都租出去了，不過還有兩台電動的。

dialogue.t: How much more do those cost? I'm on a tight budget this trip.
dialogue.zh: 那些貴多少？這趟旅行我的預算很緊。

dialogue.t: They're ten dollars more per day, but the motor helps a lot on the hills.
dialogue.zh: 它們每天貴十元，不過馬達在爬坡時幫助很大。

dialogue.t: The river path is flat, though, so I probably don't need that.
dialogue.zh: 不過河邊的步道很平坦，所以我大概不需要那個。

dialogue.t: In that case, try Pedal House two blocks north. They usually have regular bikes available.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話，可以試試往北兩個街區的 Pedal House。他們通常有一般自行車。

dialogue.t: Great, thanks. Will I need to leave a deposit or an ID?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝。我需要留押金或證件嗎？

dialogue.t: You should bring a photo ID. Most places also hold a small deposit.
dialogue.zh: 您應該帶有照片的證件。大多數店家也會收一小筆押金。

q.t: What is the woman's problem?
q.zh: 這位女士遇到什麼問題？

choices.t: The ordinary bikes she wants are all taken.
choices.zh: 她想要的一般自行車都被租走了。
choices.why: 男子說城市自行車都租出去了。

choices.t: She forgot to bring a photo ID.
choices.zh: 她忘了帶有照片的證件。
choices.why: 證件是之後才提到的，她並未說忘記帶。
她說步道很平坦，沒有說封閉。

choices.t: The electric bikes are too heavy.
choices.why: 她擔心的是價格，沒有提到重量。

q.t: How much extra do the electric bikes cost per day?
q.zh: 電動自行車每天要多付多少錢？

choices.why: 男子說每天貴十元。
二是剩下的電動自行車數量。
電動車比較貴。
押金是租車時的另一件事，不是電動車的加價。

q.t: What can be inferred about the woman's plan?
q.zh: 關於這位女士的計畫可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: She expects an easy, level ride.
choices.zh: 她預期騎的是輕鬆平坦的路線。
choices.why: 她說河邊步道平坦，不需要馬達。

choices.t: She plans to ride up steep hills.
choices.why: 她說步道是平坦的。

choices.t: She will pay extra for a motor.
choices.zh: 她會多付錢租有馬達的車。
choices.why: 她說大概不需要，且預算很緊。

choices.t: She does not have a photo ID.
choices.why: 她只是在詢問是否需要證件。

level.why: 旅客先想搭公車、因尖峰規定與班次時間改搭計程車，需推論他們對樣品的顧慮。

dialogue.t: We need to reach the convention center by six, and we'd hoped to take the city bus.
dialogue.zh: 我們六點前必須到會議中心，原本希望搭市區公車。

dialogue.t: The bus is fine, but I should mention that large suitcases aren't allowed during rush hour.
dialogue.zh: 公車可以搭，但我得說明，尖峰時段不准攜帶大型行李箱。

dialogue.t: We have two big suitcases and a case of product samples.
dialogue.zh: 我們有兩個大行李箱，還有一箱產品樣品。

dialogue.t: Oh, that's a problem. Could we pay a little extra to bring them on?
dialogue.zh: 噢，這下麻煩了。我們可以多付一點錢帶上車嗎？

dialogue.t: I'm afraid there's no option like that. Rush hour starts at five, and it's already half past four.
dialogue.zh: 恐怕沒有這種做法。尖峰時段五點開始，而現在已經四點半了。

dialogue.t: Then maybe we should leave right away and ride the bus ahead of the crowds?
dialogue.zh: 那我們是不是該馬上出發，趕在人潮之前搭公車？

dialogue.t: You could, but the next bus doesn't depart for thirty-five minutes, which puts you past five.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但下一班公車三十五分鐘後才發車，那就過五點了。

dialogue.t: In that case, a taxi seems better. Where is the nearest taxi stand?
dialogue.zh: 這樣的話，計程車似乎比較好。最近的計程車招呼站在哪裡？

dialogue.t: Walk out the east door, and you'll see it right across from the newsstand.
dialogue.zh: 從東側的門走出去，就會看到它在書報攤正對面。

dialogue.t: Thanks. It'll cost more, but at least our samples will arrive in good condition.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。雖然比較貴，但至少我們的樣品能完好無損地到達。

dialogue.t: And we won't have to rush. Let's go.
dialogue.zh: 而且我們也不用趕。走吧。

q.t: What problem do the speakers have?
q.zh: 說話者遇到什麼問題？

choices.t: Their luggage is not allowed on the bus at that time.
choices.zh: 那個時段他們的行李不能帶上公車。
choices.why: 尖峰時段不准攜帶大型行李箱。

choices.t: They have missed the last bus.
choices.zh: 他們錯過了最後一班公車。
choices.why: 對話中只說下一班要等三十五分鐘。

choices.t: The bus fare is too high.
choices.why: 他們問的是多付錢帶行李，不是車資太高。

choices.t: The convention starts earlier than planned.
choices.why: 對話只說六點前要到，沒有提前。

q.t: Why won't leaving early on the bus solve the problem?
q.zh: 為什麼提早搭公車也無法解決問題？

choices.t: The next bus leaves after rush hour begins.
choices.zh: 下一班公車在尖峰時段開始後才發車。
choices.why: 下一班三十五分鐘後發車，已過五點。

choices.t: No buses run before five o'clock.
choices.why: 對話只說下一班要等三十五分鐘，並非沒有公車。
限制是行李箱太大，不是重量。

choices.t: The taxi stand is too far away.
choices.why: 招呼站是之後才問，且就在附近。

q.t: What can be inferred about the product samples?
q.zh: 關於產品樣品可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: They could be damaged on a crowded bus.
choices.zh: 擠滿人的公車上它們可能會受損。
choices.why: 男子說搭計程車至少能讓樣品完好抵達。
他們正要把樣品帶去會議中心。

choices.t: They are very cheap to replace.
choices.why: 對話中沒有提到價格。

choices.t: They belong to the service agent.
choices.why: 樣品是男子和同伴要帶去的。

level.why: 兩人短對話，安全規定與可脫帽的地點幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Rick, please put on your hard hat before you enter the building area.
dialogue.zh: Rick，進入施工區之前請戴上你的安全帽。

dialogue.t: Sorry, I left it in my truck. I'll go get it now.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我把它留在我的卡車上。我現在就去拿。

dialogue.t: Thanks. The new rule says everyone must wear one on the site at all times.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。新規定說所有人在工地都必須隨時戴著。

dialogue.t: Understood. Is it also required in the office trailer?
dialogue.zh: 了解。在辦公室拖車裡也需要戴嗎？

dialogue.t: No, you can take it off there, but put it back on when you come out.
dialogue.zh: 不用，你可以在那裡脫下來，但出來時要再戴上。

dialogue.t: Got it. Where should I leave my lunch bag?
dialogue.zh: 知道了。我的午餐袋該放哪裡？

dialogue.t: Put it in the locker room next to the front fence.
dialogue.zh: 放在前面圍籬旁邊的置物間。

dialogue.t: Okay. I'll be back in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我兩分鐘後回來。

q.t: Why does the woman talk to the man?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼找男子說話？

choices.t: To remind him about a safety rule
choices.why: 她要他進入施工區前戴上安全帽，並說明新規定。

choices.t: To ask him to move his truck
choices.why: 卡車只是他放安全帽的地方。

choices.t: To give him a new job
choices.why: 對話沒有提到新工作。

choices.t: To tell him where to eat lunch
choices.why: 午餐袋是男子之後才問的小事。

q.t: What can be inferred about the man's hard hat?
q.zh: 關於男子的安全帽可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: He does not have it with him.
choices.why: 他說把它留在卡車上，要去拿。
規定要求所有人隨時戴著。

choices.t: He lost it on the site.
choices.why: 他是留在卡車上，不是弄丟。

choices.t: He left it in the office trailer.
choices.zh: 他把它留在辦公室拖車。
choices.why: 辦公室拖車是他之後才問到的地方。

q.t: Where is the man allowed to take off his hard hat?
q.zh: 男子可以在哪裡脫下安全帽？

choices.why: 女士說他可以在那裡脫下來。
置物間是放午餐袋的地方。
對話沒有說可以在卡車旁脫帽。
規定是在工地隨時都要戴。

level.why: 以同義換句說明因天氣調整施工時間，並需推論提早施作的原因。

dialogue.t: Have you looked at the weather report for Thursday? It says heavy rain starting around noon.
dialogue.zh: 你看過週四的天氣預報了嗎？上面說中午左右開始下大雨。

dialogue.t: I did. We were going to pour the concrete for the second floor that morning.
dialogue.zh: 看了。我們原本要在那天早上澆灌二樓的混凝土。

dialogue.t: The mixer trucks are booked for eight a.m. If the rain begins at noon, we might not finish.
dialogue.zh: 預拌車已經訂在早上八點。如果中午開始下雨，我們可能做不完。

dialogue.t: Pouring takes about six hours, so we'd be caught in the rain. Can we move it earlier?
dialogue.zh: 澆灌大約要六小時，所以我們會被雨淋到。可以提早嗎？

dialogue.t: The supplier can send trucks at five a.m. if we ask by the end of today.
dialogue.zh: 如果我們今天之內提出，供應商可以早上五點派車。

dialogue.t: Then let's do that. I'd rather start early than risk ruining the surface.
dialogue.zh: 那就這麼做。我寧可提早開始，也不想冒著毀掉表面的風險。

dialogue.t: Good. I'll call the supplier and tell the workers to be here by four thirty.
dialogue.zh: 好。我會打給供應商，並通知工人們四點半前到這裡。

dialogue.t: Perfect. I'll prepare the safety checklist tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我今晚會準備好安全檢查表。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Changing a work time because of the weather
choices.zh: 因天氣而更改工作時間
choices.why: 預報週四中午下雨，所以要把澆灌提早。
預拌車只是已預訂的車輛，沒有購買。
他們是把工作提早進行，而不是取消。
檢查表只在最後一句提到。

q.t: By when must the speakers contact the supplier?
q.zh: 說話者必須在何時之前聯絡供應商？

choices.why: 男子說今天之內提出，供應商才能早上五點派車。
週四中午是預計開始下雨的時間。
五點是供應商可派車的時間。
四點半是工人需要到場的時間。

q.t: What does the woman imply about rain and fresh concrete?
q.zh: 關於雨與剛澆灌的混凝土，這位女士暗示了什麼？

choices.t: Rain could damage the finished surface.
choices.zh: 雨可能會破壞完成的表面。
choices.why: 她寧可提早開始，也不想冒毀掉表面的風險。

choices.t: Rain makes the work go faster.
choices.why: 她擔心下雨造成問題，而不是加快進度。
工作尚未開始，她只是擔心風險。

choices.t: The supplier will charge extra for rain.
choices.zh: 供應商會因下雨加收費用。
choices.why: 對話沒有提到加收費用。

level.why: 三人對話先敲定上午吊掛、再因風速限制改到下午，並需理解同意語句的意圖。

dialogue.t: We should lift the steel beams to the fourth floor first thing tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該明天一早就把鋼樑吊到四樓。

dialogue.t: That works for me. The crane is ready, and my team can start at seven.
dialogue.zh: 我可以。起重機已準備好，我的團隊七點就能開始。

dialogue.t: Before we confirm, I looked at the wind report. Gusts could reach forty kilometers per hour in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 在確認之前，我看了風況報告。早上的陣風可能達到每小時四十公里。

dialogue.t: Is that too strong for lifting?
dialogue.zh: 那樣對吊掛來說太強了嗎？

dialogue.t: Our safety rule says we stop lifting above thirty-five.
dialogue.zh: 我們的安全規定是超過三十五就要停止吊掛。

dialogue.t: She's right. Swinging a heavy beam in strong gusts is dangerous.
dialogue.zh: 她說得對。在強陣風中擺動沉重的鋼樑很危險。

dialogue.t: Then what about the afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 那下午呢？

dialogue.t: The wind drops after one o'clock, so the afternoon should be safe.
dialogue.zh: 風在一點後會減弱，所以下午應該是安全的。

dialogue.t: Fine, we'll lift after lunch. In the morning, the workers can cut and sort the beams on the ground.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們午餐後再吊。早上工人可以在地面切割並分類鋼樑。

dialogue.t: Good idea. That way we won't waste the morning.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。這樣我們就不會浪費早上的時間。

dialogue.t: I'll inspect the crane cables at noon, so everything is ready by one.
dialogue.zh: 我中午會檢查起重機的鋼索，這樣一點前一切都會就緒。

dialogue.t: Perfect. I'll update the daily plan and send it out tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我今晚會更新每日計畫並發出去。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Rescheduling a lifting job because of the wind
choices.zh: 因風勢而重新安排吊掛作業
choices.why: 原定早上吊掛，因陣風過強改到下午。
起重機已準備好，沒有提到購買。
鋼樑是吊掛的對象，沒有說受損。
對話沒有提到訓練。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "She's right"?
q.zh: 男子說「She's right」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He agrees that strong wind is a safety risk.
choices.zh: 他同意強風是安全風險。
choices.why: 他接著說強陣風中擺動鋼樑很危險。
他支持督導的看法，不提早吊掛。

choices.t: He thinks the crane is broken.
choices.why: 他一開始說起重機已準備好。

choices.t: He wants to cancel the project.
choices.why: 對話只是改到下午，並非取消。

q.t: What will the workers do in the morning?
q.zh: 工人早上會做什麼？

choices.t: Prepare the beams on the ground
choices.why: 經理說早上工人可以在地面切割並分類鋼樑。

choices.t: Lift the beams to the fourth floor
choices.why: 吊掛已改到下午。
是安全督導中午去檢查，不是工人。
是經理今晚更新計畫。

items.tag: 查詢工作手套庫存位置

level.why: 兩人短對話，搭配簡單庫存表，只需對照品名與走道即可。

dialogue.t: I need to know where we keep the work gloves, because the new crew starts tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我需要知道工作手套放在哪裡，因為新的工班明天開始。

dialogue.t: They're in a different aisle from the safety glasses. Why do you ask?
dialogue.zh: 它們和安全眼鏡不在同一條走道。你為什麼問？

dialogue.t: We have forty workers, and each of them needs one pair, so please check we have enough.
dialogue.zh: 我們有四十位工人，每人需要一雙，所以請確認夠不夠。

dialogue.t: Let me look at the sheet. Yes, we have plenty, even after the other crews take theirs.
dialogue.zh: 我看一下表單。有，很充足，就算其他工班領走他們的也夠。

dialogue.t: Good. I'm busy until three, so could you bring them to the loading area then?
dialogue.zh: 很好。我忙到三點，所以你可以到時候把它們送到裝卸區嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. Do you also need cable ties for the electricians?
dialogue.zh: 當然。你們的電工也需要束線帶嗎？

dialogue.t: Not this time. Just the gloves, please.
dialogue.zh: 這次不用。只要手套就好。

dialogue.t: Okay. I'll bring them to the loading area at three o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我三點會把它們送到裝卸區。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which aisle will the woman go to?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這位女士會去哪一條走道？

choices.why: 男子要的是工作手套，表上手套在 B 走道，數量 80 足夠 40 位工人使用。
A 走道放安全眼鏡，女士說手套不在同一條走道。
C 走道是束線帶，男子說這次不需要。
D 走道是鋼管，對話中沒有人要鋼管。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "I'm busy until three"?
q.zh: 男子說「I'm busy until three」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He cannot collect the gloves before three o'clock.
choices.zh: 他三點前無法去領手套。
choices.why: 所以他請女士三點時把手套送到裝卸區。

choices.t: He no longer needs the gloves.
choices.why: 他最後仍說只要手套。

choices.t: The new crew starts at three.
choices.why: 新工班是明天開始，三點是送貨時間。

choices.t: He will finish all the work at three.
choices.zh: 他三點會完成所有工作。
choices.why: 他只說忙到三點，沒有說工作全部完成。

q.t: What will the woman do at three o'clock?
q.zh: 這位女士三點會做什麼？

choices.t: Bring the gloves to the loading area
choices.why: 她說三點會把手套送到裝卸區。
束線帶她問過，但男子說這次不需要。
對話沒有提到清點眼鏡。
電工只是她詢問束線帶時提到的對象。

items.tag: 安排大型貨車卸貨碼頭

level.why: 需結合碼頭時段與車長限制，再配合到達時間與卸貨時間選出合適碼頭。

dialogue.t: Our truck with the steel shelves will reach your site around twelve thirty today.
dialogue.zh: 我們載鋼製貨架的貨車今天大約十二點半會到你們那裡。

dialogue.t: Okay. How long is the vehicle? Some of our docks can't handle long ones.
dialogue.zh: 好的。車子多長？我們有些碼頭無法處理長的車。

dialogue.t: Fourteen meters. It's the largest vehicle we send.
dialogue.zh: 十四公尺。這是我們派出最大的車。

dialogue.t: I'll assign a suitable dock for you. It may mean a short wait after you arrive.
dialogue.zh: 我會為你們安排合適的碼頭。抵達後可能要稍等一下。

dialogue.t: That's fine. We're not in a hurry, as long as the unloading is done by four.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。我們不趕，只要卸貨在四點前完成就好。

dialogue.t: It will be. Unloading usually takes about an hour and a half.
dialogue.zh: 會的。卸貨通常大約要一個半小時。

dialogue.t: Great. Should I have the driver call you when he's twenty minutes away?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。要不要讓司機在離你們二十分鐘時打給你？

dialogue.t: Yes, please. I'll have a team ready as soon as he calls.
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩了。他一打來我就會讓一組人準備好。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which dock will the truck most likely use?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這輛貨車最可能使用哪個碼頭？

choices.why: 車長 14 公尺，需容許 16 公尺的碼頭；一點開放，也能在四點前卸完貨。
它十一點就結束開放，且只容許 12 公尺。
時間接近抵達時間，但只容許 8 公尺的車。
三點才開放，無法在四點前卸完，也只容許 12 公尺。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "We're not in a hurry"?
q.zh: 男子說「We're not in a hurry」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He can accept a short delay.
choices.why: 這是回應女士說抵達後可能要稍等。

choices.t: He wants the truck unloaded immediately.
choices.why: 他表示可以等。

choices.t: He has no deadline at all.
choices.why: 他仍要求四點前卸完。

choices.t: He is unsure about the truck's size.
choices.why: 他清楚回答了車長是十四公尺。

q.t: What does the woman ask the man to do?
q.zh: 這位女士要求男子做什麼？

choices.t: Have the driver call when he is nearby
choices.zh: 讓司機在接近時打電話
choices.why: 男子建議離二十分鐘時打給她，她回答好的。
對話沒有提到提早。
是女士要為他們安排碼頭。
男子說這已是最大的車，也沒有人要求換車。

level.why: 三人對話先考慮離門最近的區域、後因溫度與重量改選，並需結合圖表與三項條件判斷。

dialogue.t: The new paint order arrives tomorrow, and it weighs about six hundred kilograms in total.
dialogue.zh: 新的油漆訂單明天會到，總重大約六百公斤。

dialogue.t: Zone A is closest to the loading door, and it has forty open racks.
dialogue.zh: A 區離裝卸門最近，而且有四十個空貨架。

dialogue.t: But Zone A gets hot. The label says to keep the paint between ten and twenty-five degrees.
dialogue.zh: 但 A 區會變熱。標籤上說油漆要保存在十到二十五度之間。

dialogue.t: I forgot about that. We can't use Zone A, then.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了這點。那就不能用 A 區了。

dialogue.t: What about Zone D? It has plenty of space.
dialogue.zh: 那 D 區呢？它有很多空間。

dialogue.t: That's too cold. At five degrees, the paint could be damaged.
dialogue.zh: 那太冷了。在五度時，油漆可能會受損。

dialogue.t: Then we need the right temperature and a rack that holds all six hundred kilograms.
dialogue.zh: 那我們需要合適的溫度，以及能承重全部六百公斤的貨架。

dialogue.t: I want everything on a single rack, so it can be moved in one trip.
dialogue.zh: 我希望所有東西放在同一個貨架上，這樣一趟就能搬完。

dialogue.t: Then there's only one zone that fits all three conditions.
dialogue.zh: 那麼只有一個區域符合這三項條件。

dialogue.t: Agreed. I'll mark the rack tomorrow morning before the truck arrives.
