dialogue.zh: 同意。明天早上貨車到之前，我會標記好那個貨架。

dialogue.t: And I'll print the location labels this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 我今天下午會把位置標籤印出來。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "I forgot about that"?
q.zh: 男子說「I forgot about that」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He had overlooked the heat problem in Zone A.
choices.zh: 他先前忽略了 A 區的高溫問題。
choices.why: 他隨後說因此不能用 A 區。

choices.t: He disagrees with the paint label.
choices.why: 他接受標籤的溫度規定。

choices.t: He forgot when the order arrives.
choices.why: 對話沒有顯示他忘了到貨時間。

choices.t: He wants to use Zone D instead.
choices.why: 是女士提出 D 區，且被否決。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Where will the paint most likely be stored?
q.zh: 請看圖表。油漆最可能存放在哪裡？

choices.why: 20°C 在 10–25 度之間，單一貨架可承重 900 公斤，足以放 600 公斤。
35°C 超過油漆需要的 10–25 度。
溫度合適，但貨架只能承重 500 公斤，不夠 600 公斤。
D 區只有 5°C，太冷，已被否決。

q.t: What does the man say he will do tomorrow morning?
q.zh: 男子說他明天早上會做什麼？

choices.t: Mark the rack before the truck arrives
choices.zh: 在貨車到之前標記貨架
choices.why: 他說明天早上貨車到之前會標記貨架。
是女士今天下午要印標籤。

choices.t: Move the paint to Zone D
choices.zh: 把油漆搬到 D 區
choices.why: D 區太冷，已被否決。
對話沒有提到打電話給供應商。

level.why: 兩人短對話，問題、指示與替代方案都以直白句子說明。

dialogue.t: Mr. Hall, there's a large puddle near the loading dock, and it looks slippery.
dialogue.zh: Hall 先生，裝卸碼頭附近有一大灘水，看起來很滑。

dialogue.t: Thanks for telling me. Did anyone fall?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。有人跌倒嗎？

dialogue.t: No, but a forklift almost slid yesterday. I think a pipe is leaking above it.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但昨天有一台堆高機差點打滑。我想是上面的管線漏水。

dialogue.t: I'll call maintenance now. Can you put a warning cone there?
dialogue.zh: 我現在就打給維修部門。你可以在那裡放一個警示錐嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. We have cones by the main door.
dialogue.zh: 好。我們在大門旁有警示錐。

dialogue.t: Good. Please also tell the drivers to use the north dock until it's fixed.
dialogue.zh: 很好。也請告訴司機們，修好之前先使用北邊的碼頭。

dialogue.t: I'll tell them right away.
dialogue.zh: 我馬上告訴他們。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Maintenance should arrive within an hour.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。維修人員應該一小時內會到。

q.t: What is the woman reporting?
q.zh: 這位女士在通報什麼？

choices.t: A slippery area on the floor
choices.zh: 地板上有一處很滑的區域
choices.why: 她說裝卸碼頭附近有一大灘水，看起來很滑。
堆高機只是提到差點打滑，並沒有壞掉。
警示錐是男子之後要求她放置的，並非遺失。
維修人員還沒被叫，並沒有遲到。

q.t: What does the man ask the woman to do?
q.zh: 男子要求這位女士做什麼？

choices.t: Place a warning cone near the puddle
choices.why: 他問她能不能在那裡放一個警示錐。
要打電話的是男子自己。
對話中沒有要她修理管線。

choices.t: Drive the forklift to the north dock
choices.zh: 把堆高機開到北邊碼頭
choices.why: 他是要她通知司機改用北邊碼頭，不是要她開堆高機。

q.t: What can be inferred about the north dock?
q.zh: 關於北邊碼頭可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It is safe to use for now.
choices.why: 修好之前，經理要司機改用北邊碼頭。
如果它也漏水，就不會被指定為替代地點。
經理要司機使用它。

choices.t: It is next to the main door.
choices.why: 大門旁只是放警示錐的地方，沒有提到碼頭位置。

level.why: 以同義換句說明庫存差異的調查過程，並需推論主管對原因的懷疑。

dialogue.t: I finished counting the pallets in Section C, and the numbers don't match the system.
dialogue.zh: 我數完 C 區的棧板了，數量和系統不一致。

dialogue.t: How big is the difference? Are we missing items, or do we have extra?
dialogue.zh: 差多少？是少了東西，還是多出來？

dialogue.t: The system says one hundred twenty cartons of tiles, but I counted only one hundred.
dialogue.zh: 系統顯示有一百二十箱磁磚，但我只數到一百箱。

dialogue.t: Twenty cartons is a lot. Could some have been moved to Section D by mistake?
dialogue.zh: 二十箱不少。有沒有可能不小心被搬到 D 區？

dialogue.t: I checked there first. Section D only has bags of cement.
dialogue.zh: 我先查過那裡了。D 區只有水泥袋。

dialogue.t: Then let's review last week's outgoing orders. Maybe a truck took too many.
dialogue.zh: 那我們來檢視上週的出貨訂單。也許有車載走太多了。

dialogue.t: Good idea. I'll print the loading records and look at them this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我會列印裝載紀錄，今天下午來看。

dialogue.t: Let me know what you find, and I'll contact the customer if needed.
dialogue.zh: 有發現再告訴我，必要的話我會聯絡客戶。

q.t: What problem does the woman report?
q.zh: 這位女士回報了什麼問題？

choices.t: The actual stock is lower than the recorded amount.
choices.zh: 實際庫存比紀錄的數量少。
choices.why: 系統顯示一百二十箱，她只數到一百箱。

choices.t: Section D is full of cement.
choices.why: 水泥只是她檢查 D 區時提到的。
對話沒有提到貨車遲到。
系統有運作，只是數量與實物不符。

q.t: Where did the woman look for the missing cartons first?
q.zh: 這位女士一開始在哪裡找不見的箱子？

choices.why: 她說先查過那裡，只有水泥袋。
C 區是她盤點的地方，發現數量不符。
檢視出貨訂單是男子之後提出的做法。
對話沒有說她去查貨車。

q.t: What does the man suspect might have happened?
q.zh: 男子懷疑可能發生了什麼事？

choices.t: Too many cartons were loaded onto a truck.
choices.zh: 有太多箱子被裝上貨車。
choices.why: 他說也許有車載走太多了。
對話沒有提到損壞。
他沒有質疑她的盤點，而是去檢視出貨紀錄。

choices.t: The cement was mixed up with the tiles.
choices.why: 水泥只是 D 區存放的物品。

level.why: 三人對話先要求換貨、因生產期太長改為挪用並取得補償，需理解意圖與因果。

dialogue.t: The tiles arrived this morning, but they're gray, and we ordered white ones.
dialogue.zh: 磁磚今天早上到了，但它們是灰色的，我們訂的是白色。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry about that. Our order sheet shows the wrong color code was entered on our side.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。我們的訂單表顯示是我們這邊輸入了錯誤的顏色代碼。

dialogue.t: We need the white tiles by Friday for the lobby floor. Can you swap them quickly?
dialogue.zh: 我們週五前需要白色磁磚來鋪大廳地板。你可以很快換貨嗎？

dialogue.t: I can send the white ones, but the factory needs ten days to make that many.
dialogue.zh: 我可以送白色的，但工廠要十天才能做出那麼多。

dialogue.t: Ten days is too long. The lobby inspection is next week.
dialogue.zh: 十天太久了。大廳的驗收在下週。

dialogue.t: Then returning them makes no sense. Could we use the gray tiles in the back hallway instead?
dialogue.zh: 那退回去就沒意義了。我們能把灰色磁磚改用在後面的走廊嗎？

dialogue.t: That works. The hallway needs about half the amount.
dialogue.zh: 可以。走廊大約只需要一半的量。

dialogue.t: In that case, I can give you a twenty percent credit on the gray tiles for the mistake.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話，為這次的錯誤，我可以給你們灰色磁磚八折的補償。

dialogue.t: That's fair. If any white tiles are in stock, please send them for the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 這很合理。如果有白色磁磚的現貨，請送來給大廳用。

dialogue.t: I'll check our other storage center and call you back within the hour.
dialogue.zh: 我會查一下我們其他的倉儲中心，一小時內回電給你們。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Please call me directly, since I manage the lobby schedule.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請直接打給我，因為我負責大廳的工程時程。

q.t: What problem is being discussed?
q.zh: 他們在討論什麼問題？

choices.t: Tiles of the wrong color were sent.
choices.zh: 送來了顏色錯誤的磁磚。
choices.why: 他們訂白色，收到灰色。

choices.t: The tiles were broken in transit.
choices.why: 沒有提到破損。

choices.t: The tiles arrived a week late.
choices.why: 磁磚是今天早上到，一週是驗收的時間。
問題是顏色，不是金額。

q.t: Why can't the supplier replace the tiles quickly?
q.zh: 供應商為什麼無法很快換貨？

choices.t: The factory needs ten days to make them.
choices.why: 男子說工廠要十天才能做出那麼多。

choices.t: The supplier has no order sheet.
choices.why: 他查看了訂單表。

choices.t: The customer entered the wrong code.
choices.zh: 是客戶輸入了錯誤代碼。
choices.why: 男子說錯誤出在供應商這邊。
對話沒有提到假日。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "Then returning them makes no sense"?
q.zh: 女士說「Then returning them makes no sense」是什麼意思？

choices.t: Sending the gray tiles back would not solve the problem.
choices.zh: 把灰色磁磚退回去無法解決問題。
choices.why: 換貨要十天，趕不上驗收，所以她改提挪用。

choices.t: She wants her money back immediately.
choices.why: 她反而提出保留並使用灰色磁磚。
她只是找實際可行的使用方式。

choices.t: She is angry at the supplier.
choices.why: 她語氣務實，且接受補償。

items.tag: 客房冷氣故障要求換房

level.why: 三人對話但句子簡短，問題、新房位置與景觀都幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Hello, our air conditioner isn't working in Room 305.
dialogue.zh: 哈囉，我們 305 號房的冷氣不能用。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry about that. It's very warm today, isn't it?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。今天很熱，對吧？

dialogue.t: Yes, it feels like an oven in there. Can we change rooms?
dialogue.zh: 對，裡面感覺像烤箱。我們可以換房間嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. I have a room on the fourth floor with a lake view.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。我有一間在四樓、能看到湖景的房間。

dialogue.t: That sounds nice. Is it the same price as our old room?
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。價格和我們原本的房間一樣嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, the price is the same, and it has two beds.
dialogue.zh: 是的，價格一樣，而且有兩張床。

dialogue.t: Two beds is perfect. We have two large bags upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 兩張床太好了。我們樓上有兩個大包包。

dialogue.t: A porter can bring them to the new room for you.
dialogue.zh: 行李員可以幫你們把它們搬到新房間。

dialogue.t: Thank you. How long will we have to wait?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。我們要等多久？

dialogue.t: About ten minutes. Please enjoy a cold drink in the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 大約十分鐘。請在大廳享用一杯冷飲。

dialogue.t: That's a great idea. We'll sit by the window.
dialogue.zh: 這主意很棒。我們會坐在窗邊。

q.t: What problem do the guests have?
q.zh: 房客遇到什麼問題？

choices.t: The cooling system in their room is broken.
choices.zh: 他們房間的冷卻設備壞了。
choices.why: 女士說 305 號房的冷氣不能用。
對話沒有提到房間大小。
價格是之後詢問新房時才問到。
沒有提到床的清潔。

q.t: What can be inferred about Room 305?
q.zh: 關於 305 號房可以推論出什麼？

choices.why: 男子說裡面感覺像烤箱。
湖景是新房間的特色。

choices.t: It is on the fourth floor.
choices.why: 四樓是新房間的位置。
對話沒有說舊房間的床數。

q.t: What can the guests see from the new room?
q.zh: 房客從新房間可以看到什麼？

choices.why: 櫃檯人員說新房間有湖景。
大廳是他們等待時去的地方。
對話沒有提到花園。
對話沒有提到街景。

items.tag: 水管漏水協調維修時間

level.why: 以同義換句說明漏水維修的時間協調，並需由對話推論女士當天的工作安排。

dialogue.t: Good morning. I'm the plumber your landlord sent about the kitchen sink.
dialogue.zh: 早安。我是你們房東派來處理廚房水槽的水電工。

dialogue.t: Thanks for coming. The leak started two days ago, and it's getting worse.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你來。漏水是兩天前開始的，而且越來越嚴重。

dialogue.t: We put a bucket under it, but it fills up every evening.
dialogue.zh: 我們在下面放了水桶，但每天晚上都會裝滿。

dialogue.t: I see. I'll have to take the pipe apart and use a drill, so it will be loud for about two hours.
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。我得把水管拆開並使用電鑽，所以大約兩小時會很吵。

dialogue.t: Two hours? I have a video call at ten, so I can't work with that noise.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時？我十點有視訊會議，有那種噪音我沒辦法工作。

dialogue.t: I'm free this afternoon. Could you start after lunch?
dialogue.zh: 我今天下午有空。你可以午餐後再開始嗎？

dialogue.t: I have another job at two, so I'd have to come back tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 我兩點還有另一個工作，所以我得明天早上再來。

dialogue.t: Tomorrow works for me. I'm free all morning.
dialogue.zh: 明天我可以。我整個早上都有空。

dialogue.t: In the meantime, can you stop the leak temporarily so we don't need the bucket?
dialogue.zh: 在那之前，你可以暫時止住漏水，這樣我們就不需要水桶了嗎？

dialogue.t: Yes, I can tighten the joint now. It will hold until tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我現在可以鎖緊接頭。它撐到明天沒問題。

dialogue.t: Great, thank you. We'll see you at eight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你。我們八點見。

q.t: Why is the man at the apartment?
q.zh: 男子為什麼來到這間公寓？

choices.why: 他說是房東派他來處理廚房水槽漏水。
派他來的是房東，他本人是水電工。
水桶是房客暫時用來接水的。
電鑽是他維修時用的工具。

q.t: What can be inferred about the first woman?
q.zh: 關於第一位女士可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: She will be working at home this morning.
choices.zh: 她今天早上會在家工作。
choices.why: 她十點有視訊會議，不能有噪音。
房東只是派水電工的人。

choices.t: She will be away all day.
choices.why: 她明天早上有空，今天早上有視訊會議。

choices.t: She wants the leak left alone.
choices.why: 她同意明天早上來修。

q.t: Why can't the man work in the afternoon?
q.zh: 男子下午為什麼不能工作？

choices.why: 他說兩點還有另一個工作。
午餐是室友提議的開工時間點。

choices.t: The noise is not allowed after two.
choices.why: 兩點是他另一個工作的時間。
對話沒有提到房東會來。

items.tag: 會議住宿房型因早餐改訂

level.why: 三人對話先選價格最低的房型、後因早餐承諾改選，並需結合房型表與預算判斷。

dialogue.t: We need eight rooms for our guests attending next month's sales conference.
dialogue.zh: 我們需要八間房，給下個月參加業務會議的賓客。

dialogue.t: Certainly. For how many nights, and what is your budget per room?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。要住幾晚，每間房的預算是多少？

dialogue.t: Three nights, and we'd like to stay under one hundred twenty dollars per room per night.
dialogue.zh: 三晚，而且我們希望每間每晚低於一百二十元。

dialogue.t: Since that's the budget, let's just take the lowest-priced rooms to save money.
dialogue.zh: 既然這是預算，我們就直接選價格最低的房間來省錢吧。

dialogue.t: The Standard Single is ninety dollars, and we have fourteen of them.
dialogue.zh: 標準單人房是九十元，我們有十四間。

dialogue.t: That sounds ideal. Wait, does that rate include breakfast? Our guests have early meetings.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很理想。等等，那個價格有含早餐嗎？我們的賓客有早場會議。

dialogue.t: I'm afraid breakfast isn't included with the single rooms.
dialogue.zh: 恐怕單人房不含早餐。

dialogue.t: Then it's not ideal. Breakfast was part of the invitation we sent to everyone.
dialogue.zh: 那就不理想了。早餐是我們寄給大家的邀請函內容之一。

dialogue.t: You're right. Is there another room type under our price ceiling that comes with breakfast?
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。有沒有另一種房型在我們的價格上限內，而且附早餐？

dialogue.t: Yes, one other type is within your budget, and breakfast comes with it. We have enough for all eight.
dialogue.zh: 有，另一種房型在你們的預算內，而且附早餐。我們的房間數足夠給八位。

dialogue.t: Excellent. Let's switch to that, and I'll sign the form now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們改訂那種，我現在就簽表格。

q.t: What are the men trying to do?
q.zh: 這兩位男子想做什麼？

choices.why: 他們需要八間房給業務會議的賓客。
他們是在訂房。

choices.t: Change the date of a conference
choices.why: 對話沒有提到日期變更。
對話沒有提到信用卡。

q.t: What does the second man mean when he says, "Then it's not ideal"?
q.zh: 第二位男子說「Then it's not ideal」是什麼意思？

choices.t: The single rooms would not meet a promise made to the guests.
choices.zh: 單人房無法符合對賓客的承諾。
choices.why: 他接著說早餐是邀請函內容之一。

choices.t: He thinks the single rooms cost too much.
choices.why: 單人房 $90 在預算內，問題是沒有早餐。

choices.t: He wants to cancel the conference.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到取消會議。
邀請函是他們自己寄給賓客的。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which room type will the men most likely book?
q.zh: 請看圖表。兩位男子最可能訂哪一種房型？

choices.why: 每晚 $110 低於 $120、有 9 間足夠八位賓客，且含早餐。
價格和數量符合，但不含早餐。
$140 超過每晚 $120 的預算。
$220 超出預算，且只有 2 間，不夠八位。
